cards.name: The Fool
cards.up: Reckless leap with zero plan — thrilling right up until you hit the ground. Naivety dressed up as freedom.
cards.rev: You've been played for a fool, or you're about to be. Stop ignoring the red flags.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.up: You have every tool you need — the only thing stopping you is your own excuses.
cards.rev: Manipulative, all talk. Someone (maybe you) is bullshitting their way through this.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.up: Your gut already knows the answer. Stop asking people who know less than you do.
cards.rev: You're lying to yourself. Secrets are rotting quietly and it's catching up.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.up: Abundance, fertility, comfort — but check whether you're nurturing something or smothering it.
cards.rev: Neglect, burnout, or an unhealthy dependence. Something (or someone) is being starved of care.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.up: Control and structure that actually work. Don't mistake rigidity for strength.
cards.rev: A control freak running the show into the ground. Ego over sense.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.up: Tradition and rules exist for a reason — follow the system this once.
cards.rev: Blind conformity or hollow rebellion for its own sake. Neither is actually thinking for yourself.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.up: A real choice, a real bond — but it demands you actually show up for it.
cards.rev: A relationship built on convenience, imbalance, or flat-out incompatibility. Wake up.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.up: Sheer will drags this over the line. Discipline, not luck.
cards.rev: You're steering nothing — this is chaos with your name on it. Get a grip.

cards.name: Strength
cards.up: Quiet, stubborn courage. You're stronger than the situation, even if it doesn't feel like it.
cards.rev: Self-doubt eating you alive, or you're forcing dominance instead of earning it.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.up: Withdraw and think. Everyone else's noise is drowning out your own answer.
cards.rev: Isolation curdling into loneliness. You've disappeared and no one's noticed — including you.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.up: Change is coming whether you're ready or not. Grip loosens, deal with it.
cards.rev: A losing streak that feels personal but isn't. Bad luck, not punishment — ride it out.

cards.name: Justice
cards.up: Consequences land exactly where they should. No shortcuts, no favours.
cards.rev: An unfair outcome, or you dodging accountability you clearly deserve.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.up: Nothing moves until you stop fighting it. Surrender is the strategy here.
cards.rev: Stalling on purpose because moving forward terrifies you. Self-sabotage with a nicer name.

cards.name: Death
cards.up: Something is ending, fully, and no amount of clinging saves it. Let it die.
cards.rev: Refusing to let go of something already dead. Decay while you pretend it's fine.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.up: Balance earned through patience, not luck. Slow blending beats forcing it.
cards.rev: Excess, overcorrection, an all-or-nothing mess. You've lost the middle ground entirely.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.up: You're chained to something toxic — a habit, a person, a pattern — and you know it.
cards.rev: The chains are loosening. Waking up to how trapped you actually were.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.up: Sudden, brutal collapse of something built on a lie. It had to fall.
cards.rev: You're delaying the inevitable crash. The longer you wait, the worse the wreckage.

cards.name: The Star
cards.up: Real hope after real damage — not naive, earned. Keep going.
cards.rev: Despair, burnt-out faith, feeling forgotten. The hope's gone quiet, not gone forever.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.up: You're being deceived — maybe by someone else, maybe by your own anxiety. Trust nothing at face value.
cards.rev: The fog's clearing. A hard truth finally surfaces after a long confusion.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.up: Straightforward good fortune, no asterisks. Enjoy it without overthinking it.
cards.rev: Delayed joy, or a happiness you're faking for an audience. Check what's real.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.up: A reckoning — you're being called to answer for something, good or bad.
cards.rev: Avoiding a wake-up call you badly need. Denial isn't a plan.

cards.name: The World
cards.up: Full completion. You earned this ending — don't rush into the next thing yet.
cards.rev: Unfinished business dragging on. Loose ends you keep pretending are tied.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.up: A hard, undeniable spark of ambition. Act on it now or watch it fizzle.
cards.rev: False start, or motivation you're faking. The spark isn't really there yet.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.up: Big plans, but you're still just staring at the map. Commit or stay stuck.
cards.rev: Fear of leaving the comfort zone is costing you the whole opportunity.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.up: Expansion is working — but don't get comfortable, this is only the beginning.
cards.rev: Delays and obstacles you didn't plan for. Your timeline was too optimistic.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.up: Genuine celebration, a milestone actually earned. Let yourself enjoy it.
cards.rev: A celebration that feels hollow, or instability under a happy surface.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.up: Petty conflict, everyone fighting for the sake of fighting. Exhausting and pointless.
cards.rev: Conflict avoided by burying it — it'll resurface uglier later.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.up: A real win, publicly earned. Take the credit, you did the work.
cards.rev: Recognition denied, or a win that turns out to be empty and short-lived.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.up: You're outnumbered and defending ground that matters. Stand firm, it's worth it.
cards.rev: You're worn down and losing the fight. Know when defending becomes pointless.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.up: Fast-moving momentum — things are about to happen quickly, ready or not.
cards.rev: Frustrating delays, crossed wires, communication that keeps missing.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.up: Battered but not broken. One more push, even though you're exhausted.
cards.rev: Paranoid exhaustion — defending against threats that aren't even there anymore.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.up: Carrying more than you should, alone, because you refuse to delegate. It's crushing you.
cards.rev: Burnout. Time to put something down before it breaks you.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.up: Impulsive curiosity, an idea worth chasing even half-formed.
cards.rev: All talk, no follow-through. Excitement that never becomes action.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.up: Reckless, fast, impatient action. Might work, might blow up in your face.
cards.rev: Impulsiveness with no direction — burning energy on something going nowhere.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.up: Confident, magnetic, unapologetically herself. Doesn't need permission.
cards.rev: Insecurity dressed up as confidence, or jealousy poisoning the room.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.up: A leader who actually delivers on vision, not just talk.
cards.rev: Arrogance and impulsive control — leading through ego, not competence.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.up: New emotional opening — real feeling, not performative. Let it in.
cards.rev: Emotional blockage, or feelings you're refusing to let yourself have.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.up: Genuine mutual connection. Rare — don't take it for granted.
cards.rev: A one-sided connection, or a breakup brewing under the surface.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.up: Real friendship worth celebrating. Community that actually shows up for you.
cards.rev: Gossip, overindulgence, or friendships that are more surface than substance.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.up: Apathy — you're so in your head you're missing an opportunity right in front of you.
cards.rev: Finally snapping out of the funk and noticing what's available.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.up: Grieving what's lost while ignoring what's still standing. Look up.
cards.rev: Starting to accept the loss and move forward, slowly.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.up: Nostalgia — maybe useful, maybe keeping you stuck in a past that's gone.
cards.rev: Living in the past to the point it's stunting you now.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.up: Too many options, none of them examined honestly. Fantasy over reality.
cards.rev: Finally cutting through the illusions and choosing something real.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.up: Walking away from something that looks fine but isn't fulfilling anymore. Trust that.
cards.rev: Staying in something you already know is dead, out of fear.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.up: Genuine satisfaction — the ‘wish fulfilled’ card, actually earned.
cards.rev: Empty indulgence, satisfaction that's shallow and won't last.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.up: Real, lasting emotional fulfilment. Not perfect, but genuinely good.
cards.rev: A picture-perfect image hiding real cracks underneath.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.up: An emotional message or idea arriving — a little naive, but sincere.
cards.rev: Emotional immaturity, moodiness, creative ideas that go nowhere.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.up: A romantic offer or invitation — charming, but check if it's substance or just style.
cards.rev: Empty charm, moodiness, someone selling you a fantasy they can't deliver.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.up: Deep emotional intelligence and compassion — know your limits before you drown in others' feelings.
cards.rev: Emotional manipulation, or drowning in your own feelings with no boundaries.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.up: Emotional control — calm under pressure, feels everything but isn't ruled by it.
cards.rev: Emotional repression finally leaking out sideways, or manipulative moodiness.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.up: A sharp, clarifying truth cuts through the noise. Use it.
cards.rev: Confusion, or a truth twisted into a weapon against you.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.up: Deliberate avoidance of a decision. You know the answer, you just hate it.
cards.rev: Forced to finally decide — the standoff can't continue.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.up: Brutal heartbreak. Betrayal, grief, pain with no soft edges. It hurts because it's real.
cards.rev: The wound is old but you keep reopening it. Time to actually heal.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.up: Forced rest. Your body or mind is shutting things down whether you agree or not.
cards.rev: Burnout from refusing to rest when you clearly needed to.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.up: A hollow win — you got your way and lost respect doing it.
cards.rev: Fallout from a conflict you ‘won’ too aggressively. Reputation damage.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.up: Moving away from a mess, slowly, painfully, but it's the right direction.
cards.rev: Stuck in transition — can't leave the wreckage behind yet.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.up: Deception — someone (maybe you) cutting corners or lying to get ahead.
cards.rev: Getting caught. The scheme unravels and there's nowhere to hide.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.up: Trapped by your own thinking, not by actual circumstances. The exit's right there.
cards.rev: Finally seeing you were never as stuck as you believed.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.up: 3am anxiety spiralling out of control. The fear is louder than the actual threat.
cards.rev: Finally facing the thing you've been catastrophising about — relief follows.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.up: Total, brutal collapse. It can't get worse than this — which means it's over.
cards.rev: Refusing to accept an ending that's already happened. Prolonging the pain.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.up: Sharp curiosity, maybe gossip. Watch what you say before you know the full story.
cards.rev: Reckless words causing real damage. Think before the next sentence.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.up: Aggressive, fast, cutting through obstacles with no patience for consequences.
cards.rev: Recklessness that's about to blow up in your face — slow down.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.up: Cold, clear-eyed honesty. She'll tell you the truth whether you want it or not.
cards.rev: Cruelty dressed as honesty. Using sharpness to hurt, not to help.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.up: Ruthless logic — decisions made on fact, feelings be damned.
cards.rev: Cold-blooded manipulation, using intellect to dominate rather than clarify.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.up: A real, tangible opportunity — money, a job, a foundation. Take it seriously.
cards.rev: A missed opportunity, or a financial foundation that's actually shaky.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.up: Juggling multiple demands, barely — it's manageable but only just.
cards.rev: Dropping the ball. You've overcommitted and something's about to fall apart.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.up: Solid teamwork that's actually working, skill recognised.
cards.rev: Poor teamwork, clashing egos, work sabotaged by lack of coordination.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.up: Hoarding out of fear, not need. Loosen the grip before it costs you more.
cards.rev: Financial insecurity finally forcing you to let go and spend or share.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.up: Real hardship — financial, physical, or being left out in the cold. It's rough.
cards.rev: Recovery starting after the hardship, help finally arriving.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.up: Fair exchange — help given or received without strings, for once.
cards.rev: A power imbalance in giving and receiving — charity with control attached, or exploitation.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.up: Patiently waiting for effort to pay off. It's not wasted, it's just slow.
cards.rev: Impatience about to make you quit right before the payoff.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.up: Grinding, skill-building, unglamorous work that's actually going somewhere.
cards.rev: Sloppy, careless effort — cutting corners that will show later.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.up: Self-sufficient comfort, earned alone. Enjoy it without guilt.
cards.rev: Isolation dressed up as independence. The comfort's a little lonely.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.up: Long-term security, legacy, generational stability. The big picture is solid.
cards.rev: Family money conflict, or short-term thinking wrecking long-term stability.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.up: A real, grounded opportunity to learn a new skill. Take it seriously, it compounds.
cards.rev: Procrastination, unrealistic plans, all study and no execution.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.up: Slow, steady, unglamorous progress. Boring but it's actually working.
cards.rev: Stagnation dressed up as caution. You're not being careful, you're stuck.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.up: Practical nurturing — comfort that's actually useful, not just performative.
cards.rev: Neglecting yourself while over-caring for everyone else. Refill your own cup.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.up: Real, earned material success — generous because he can actually afford to be.
cards.rev: Greed, or success built on exploiting people under him.

cards.name: The Fool
cards.up: 'I am the Accomplishment, inner alchemy of the Fool, 'Spirit of Aether'. I come that you may make a new beginning, knowing all that's needed for your own Accomplishment is ready to unfold. Follow the vision and path of the Fool and all shall be well.I am Artisan of the Fiery, Scintillating Intelligence, 'ever-becoming Truth' bringing Light to all travellers. Holding me in the mind's eye, the Fool steps out with trust to weave the first Way. So will you, dear Alchemist.Let sparks of interest Light the fire. Enter my golden garden of musical harmonies, where Hoopoe teaches vision. Talk with my Philosophers under a wide sky. Cross my alchemical waters, then climb the steps unto radiant heraldic Accomplishment. You will have begun weaving the Four Worlds, and glimpsed the animating 'Sun behind the Sun', Quintessence and inspiration for the journey.My illumination is given to you as a traveller's guide and pattern, for my Alchemy links the 'Point' of each world with the Zodiac Circle of experience. Contemplate my Elemental symbols of transformation. Enter my Chapel, for it is a Temple of the Heart. Your True Self, the beloved Friend, is always already here within, welcoming you to 'Meetings In The Heart's Radiant Awareness.'

cards.name: The Magician
cards.up: 'I am the Alchemist, inner alchemy of the Magician, 'Magus of Power'. I bring Light to your Understanding, that new and skilful adaptations shape your vision. Through me you will build a new 'House of Thought' giving joyful shelter to your finest ideals.I am Artisan of the Intelligence of Transparency, shining the radiance of the Four Worlds through the Visionary Imagination. I inspire the inner eye of the Magician by the high Quest lettered on my banner; 'Let us go and seek the Natures of the Elements'. My Golden Garden brings you to the inner heights where I stand to point the Way. See how the verdant Tree of Life matches my size; human form a micro-cosmos to the great macro-cosmos.I hold the Mercurial vessel of transformation, for, through my Alchemy, the very substances of Eternity are Patterned, Created, Formed and Expressed, 'bringing the Point to Saturn'.Dear Alchemist, my Living Powers appear upon the altar of the Magician in symbols of Fire, Water, Air and Earth. Know that these are Elements of all Life, teaching 'As Above, so Below'. Wield them well! Adapt your old stories to higher ideals, founded on Unity, for in that clearer Alchemical Light, all can be separated then re-joined anew.'

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.up: 'I am the Fountain Knight, inner alchemy of the High Priestess, 'Priestess of the Silver Star'. I deepen your reflections into a consciousness-making Art, the Alchemical 'Essence of Glory'. Through me, repetition is transformed to revelation, bringing new powers of awareness.I am Artisan of the Uniting Intelligence, glorious Truth known only through individual spiritual experience. I stand upon the twin alchemical waters, in service to my Lady, the High Priestess, whose presence unites life's two pillars. I am her inner guide on the long path uniting Sun-Heart and Supernal-Head. Together we transform desert-toil to glorious vision, weaving the Star-lit way of Mithraic Light by which all 'dia-bolic' pulling apart becomes 'sym-bolic' bringing together.The High Priestess guards a scroll of hidden Knowledge. I reveal its secrets to her inward eye, unfurling upon my shield the great recipe for the Alchemical Art, in all Four Worlds.Dear Alchemist, be amongst those 'who seek to create the Sun and the Moon'. I will help you cultivate the Symbolic Life by which this new way of seeing can be yours. Through deep reflection and self-adjustment, you will 'Make one Water out of the Two Waters' as the recipe demands, uniting my Fountain's Silver Spirit of Mercury and Golden Soul of Sulphur.'

cards.name: The Empress
cards.up: 'I am the Royal Pair, inner Alchemy of the Empress, 'Daughter of the Mighty Ones'. I come that you may cherish and set in order your mental imagery. I help you link memory to imagination, that the children of your mind may come forth in beauty, happiness, pleasure and success.I am Artisan of the Luminous Intelligence, by which 'fundamental ideas of holiness' are prepared. Dear Alchemist, let your preparations make you a vessel of serenity and poise, like the Empress and her unborn child. Her inward eye sees in me the Universal Way to unite Wisdom and Understanding, Zodiac-Saturn, in the Four Worlds. My Alchemy opens the Door to 'a Brilliant Oneness' of new Life. Your new-born 'Particular' Truths will be as hers; individual beloved offspring of the All-Creative.I am the Alchemical Promise. As White Queen, I stand upon Earth and Water, blessed by the Silver Moon. As Red King, I stand upon Fire and Air, blessed by the Golden Sun. In my beautifully patterned mandala shines all the potential of the Imaginal as joyful wedding-day between Above and Below. Like the Renaissance Art of the Imitatio, I am a vision by which to educate sub-consciousness. Become the vision. Co-Create all the illumination of the harmoniously woven worlds.'

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.up: 'I am the Mountain, inner alchemy of the Emperor, 'Sun of the Morning, Chief among the Mighty'. I come that you may learn the right use of ambition and challenge, focusing the beam of concentration to set things in order. Cleanse the doors of perception. Look out through the windows of your soul.I am Artisan of the Constituting Intelligence, 'substance of creation in the darkness of the world'. All Zodiac-Sun experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. My Alchemical Mountain is the Emperor's inner inspiration. At my foundation is the Persian-Hebrew tale of brave Esther, daring to confront her Royal husband with unwelcome knowledge, despite the death penalty for her act. But his Love proves stronger than conventions of worldly Power, and she and her people are saved.I show how the Light of these Eternal Truths awaits the prepared eye, for look how my Mountain form symbolises the human skull undergoing transformation! True courage joins the miners as they remove 'the mote in the eye' that prevents clear seeing.Dear Alchemist, go to that Alchemical mine, where alone the prime material can be found. Ask humbly, 'what is mine?' Dig deep. All the treasures you need are concealed within.'

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.up: 'I am the Great Tree, inner alchemy of the Hierophant, 'Magus of the Eternal'. I bring the opportunity to cultivate yogic arts of Union, linking the personal to the universal through symbols of power and divine wisdom.I am Artisan of the Triumphant and Eternal Intelligence, 'a paradise prepared for the righteous'. All Zodiac-Jupiter experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. My Great Tree is the inner delight of the solemn Hierophant, for I inspire that great mystical office. My foundation is the parable of King Solomon's parents. David, musician become King, secretly watches beautiful Bathsheba, then manipulates her into marriage. All is unfruitful until he listens humbly to inward Truth. Only then can Solomon be born. As greatest King, 'Sol-om-on' reveals matter's spiritual Alchemy, building the Universal Temple, shaped at once human and Divine.In my inner paradise, 'Heaven has opened and bedewed the earth', and the Temple, as a Great Tree with silver trunk and precious fruits, extends 'to the ends of the earth'.Dear Alchemist, know yourself as just such a Tree. Be blessed by the bird-song, that you, too, may give blessings to others. For as often as you give away one 'Golden Bough', another grows in its place.'

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.up: 'I am the Golden King, inner alchemy of the Lovers, 'Children of the Voice, Oracle of the Mighty Gods'. I come that you may learn to unite and transcend difficulties in pursuit of Divine Love, bringing inspiration and impulse together into loving actions.I am Artisan of the Disposing Intelligence, clothing forms with radiance of Holy Spirit, through discernment and right relationships. All Saturn-Sun experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. To the inward eye of those 'twin souls', the Lovers, I present that radiance as a bright dawn. See how in me the Morning Star, Venus, accompanies the Animate Sun; a Shining-Messenger helping old earthly disputes sink beneath the waves.I show that 'a red degree of heat' disturbs all into a blackness, to be tended like Night until 'the King of all the Earth', embodiment of Divine Love, is renewed in Gold. Bright Sol breaks through in manifold colours, and 'a fragrant scent surpassing all balm' arises from the Earth.Dear Alchemist, great truths of spiritual evolution come alive for the Alchemical Lovers of the many kingdoms. Mineral, vegetable, animal, human and super-human constantly dissolve and re-form; our high Arts helping each to rebirth in finer, more radiant attire.'

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.up: 'I am the Welcoming Angel, inner alchemy of the Chariot, 'Child of the Powers of the Waters; Lord of the Triumph of Light'. I inspire the journey out of indecision and negativities. My embrace will teach of victory, health and success.I am Artisan of the Intelligence of the House of Influence; an abundance of Light increasing 'the influx of good things upon created beings'. All Saturn-Mars experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. To the Charioteer I am a beloved inner vision, safeguard and refuge for those bravely crossing the Cancerian waters of life. Gaze upon my beautiful, many-coloured robe of creation, for I am a radiant Truth, Star-crowned. I am here for you no matter how deep the mud. Reach for me with confidence, for I await you. Together we can travel far into the 'within-ness' of self-realisation.I am both Chariot and destination, carrying you when mental and emotional attributes are balanced, thought and speech travelling light. I dissolve what holds you back, transforming 'body into soul and soul into spirit, that they may once more be united'. Be as the great ones dear Alchemist, reaching, always reaching, towards the sweet Perfumes and Presence of the Angel.'

cards.name: Strength
cards.up: 'I am the Rebis, double-bodied one, inner alchemy of Strength, 'Daughter of the Flaming Sword. Leader of the Lion'. I come that courage and strength flow through you as balanced powers, rising safely as a radiant gift you may shine upon others.I am Artisan of the Intelligence of the Secret of Works, diffusing an influence from 'the most high blessing'. All Jupiter-Mars experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. I am Strength's inward vision, holding the balance of 'all the activities of spiritual beings', so she may raise the Lion's serpent-symbol powers of Fire to those of Light. As Rebis, I am female-male united, different yet equal. In me 'the two bodies of this Art, Sun and Moon, which are Earth and Water', have combined forces. By assimilating both earthly and spiritual food, I will bring forth the higher powers of the fifth, Quintessence.Through my Arts, brute will-power is transmuted into 'willing-ness to serve', and tremendous creative powers are tenderly born, like the chick from the egg. Only Strength can hold all steady; awakened consciousness inspiring the sub-conscious to accept and tame the powers as they rise. Learn this dear Alchemist, and you drink the healing Tincture of the Sun.'

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.up: 'I am the Golden Head, inner alchemy of the Hermit, 'Prophet of the Eternal, Magus of the Voice of Power'. I come to help you seek Wisdom from Above, and actively receive Divine inspiration.I am Artisan of the Intelligence of Will, preparing all to experience 'the existence of the primordial glory'. All Jupiter-Sun experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. The Hermit, attaining to freedom through stern discipline, hears the message of Mithraic Light given by the Warrior-guardian at the door of the Higher Mysteries; 'I have slain you that you may possess abundant life'. Discarded parts are 'made sacred', to fertilise Virgin Earth 'and bring forth fruits unnumbered'. The Hermit goes forward, bearing the Alchemical Quintessence as a golden lantern of Truth.I am the inward vision of that Lamp; my 'Golden Head' the ancient symbol of the Alchemists. As a radiant microcosm, its golden Sun-centre shines bright, guiding a delighted obedience to the Divine Beloved.Dear Alchemist, know that along the way the Will is differentiated into manifold helpers. They ensure karmic events and consequences are named and 'faced', that the Warrior-guardian of your soul may enact sacred transformations, and abundant life be your Golden attainment.'

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.up: 'I am the Philosopher, inner alchemy of the Wheel of Fortune, 'Lord of the Forces of Life'. I come to help you adapt positively to changes, cultivating good fortune, and happy, revivifying experiences.I am Artisan of the Rewarding Intelligence; a divine benediction 'upon all and each existence' which you receive in measure, according to how first you send it out. All Jupiter-Venus experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.My Philosophic bath is circular like Life's Wheel, and I am its inward Truth, Wise Old Man, 'made young again' through philosophic drama. Alchemy does not await the slow turn of the wheel over many lifetimes. I choose to be 'cut into pieces and boiled until perfectly cooked', accelerating personal evolution in 'a work against nature', transcending the slow cycles to enable greater service to others.Deep retrospection begins the process. Dear Alchemist, cast into my cauldron all hardened old attitudes of distrust, critical distain, narrow-mindedness, cynicism. Invite a dedicated part of yourself to keep the fire burning.When the white bird of Holy Spirit descends, blessing the transformation, you will indeed grow young and supple again; a keeper of the sacred trust at the high altar of the heart.'

cards.name: Justice
cards.up: 'I am the Young Dragon, inner alchemy of Justice, 'Daughter of the Lords of Truth, Ruler of the Balance'. I teach the transformative Truths of eternal justice and balance, that you may restore clarity and fairness in every part.I am Artisan of the Faithful Intelligence, for I never betray Truth. Through me 'spiritual values are increased'. All Mars-Sun experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. To the inward eye of Justice I am the full working of the Liberating Law, for I challenge ignorance and distortion of the eternal Balance. Unflinching under a heavy Saturn sky, Necessity's sword deals out life's labours and agedness. Yet I exalt Saturn, for through the greater Law of rebirth, I re-appear in the transformative flask, 'a new Earth' to be taught.My degree of heat will soften and melt 'the portions of earth that have become thick and hard-boiled', so you can receive 'the powers of fire and water' as gifts of spirit and soul.Dear Alchemist, my secret is 'the magic of appreciation', the liberating acknowledgement that all has its established place, beauty and enduringness, yet also its ever-changing-ness and becoming. Carefully weigh competing values, and you will become adept at adjustment and self-healing.'

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.up: 'I am the Turning Birds, inner alchemy of the Hanged Man, 'Spirit of the Mighty Waters'. I bring you the opportunity to turn an old way of seeing 'on its head', revealing new, transcendent values.I am Artisan of the Stable Intelligence, which has 'the virtue of consistency'; firm ground of being of eternal Truths, holding secure the worlds of ephemeral change. All Mars-Mercury experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.I am the initiate's Way, blessed by Jupiter's priestly gift of the 'reigning' Waters. The calm initiate-to-be contemplates my Turning as a meditation. Through yogic enactment the 'suspended mind' raises the imaginalising 'thought of the heart' above the isolating rationality of the brain. A new perspective is born.By the power of my pearl-white degree of heat, 'all darkness is expelled from the earth and so it lights up'. My Three Birds raise in turn the colours of the alchemical stages, making 'every black thing white and every white thing red'. Earth is subtilized, taking on the colour of a ruby.Dear Alchemist, let consciousness be so raised, and supported from Above by the Eternal Verities. Walk upon the firmament on high, like the Egyptian initiate of old.'

cards.name: Death
cards.up: 'I am the White Bird, inner alchemy of Death, 'Child of the great Transformers, Lord of the Gates of Death'. I come that you may re-imagine stereotypes, releasing my triumphant ever-living Powers.I am Artisan of the Imaginative Intelligence, bringing you vision to create your inner images and stories 'in like manner to the harmonious elegancies'. All Sun-Venus experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.I am the White Soul-Bird of three-fold sublimation; a noble Scorpio Eagle rising triumphant over the worldly abuse of Mars energies. I bring enlightenment to the Horseman of Peace, whose message of transformation is received as nothing but an ending. My red degree of heat releases forms bound by human ignorance. Turning to face the sunrise once more, they are transformed, taking sublime, ever more radiant, appearance.Dear Alchemist, I teach the great truth that all changes are changes in mental imagery. Allow stereotyped image a new life! 'Make the corporeal things spiritual, and make volatile what is fixed'. Hear the True celestial music of the Divine heartbeat whose rhythms are constant in all worlds. Take refuge in the animating 'Sun behind the Sun' where all Truths are born again and again.'

cards.name: Temperance
cards.up: 'I am the Triple Dragon, inner alchemy of Temperance, 'Daughter of the Reconcilers, Bringer Forth of Life'. I come that new arts and creativity may flow from your hands, blending profound insights with practical actions.I am Artisan of the Intelligence of Challenge, by which practitioners strive to live-up-to inspiring glimpses of Splendors to come, becoming 'probationers' on the Way. All Sun-Moon experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.I am the Dragon of Earth, inner vision of the glorious Reconciling Angel. In the crimson heat of the flask, beneath the Solar chariot racing Sagittarian across the sky, I 'let myself be melted' into Water of Life, from which springs the Triple Fire of consciousness. As water, I flow in Her vessels, from Sun Above to Moon Below, uniting all three in one creative flow.Dear Alchemist, learn how to blend my three Fires, and find the middle, mediating Way. Objective consciousness is limited to Earth, separating gross from subtle. Subjectivity is the wiser, merciful partner; vast treasure-house of story and symbol linking you to the many worlds. Higher-awareness is an all-pervading radiance, like unto the Angel herself. She 'tempers' and aligns my Fiery-Waters, that practical Life, too, may be illumined.'

cards.name: The Devil
cards.up: 'I am the Peacock, inner alchemy of the Devil, 'Lord of the Gates of Matter, Child of the Forces of Time'. I am life's most positive and most misunderstood power. I come to help you challenge ugly reversals of beautiful material powers, restoring them to forces of delight and creation.I am Artisan of the Renewing Intelligence, aligning creative processes with Divine Creation, to renew 'all the changing things'. All Sun-Mercury experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.I am the radiant inward vision of life lived forwards, not 'lived' backwards, which merely spells 'devil'! My many-coloured 'Peacock's tale' arises under Venus skies of bright Lucifer, the light-bringer, whose alchemy transforms goat-foot ignor-ance to golden age radiance in the garden of delights. See my thousand shimmering 'eyes' reveal the right use of Love's generative powers.Dear Alchemist, only those who can quicken the soul will see its colour, but, 'this steam must rise up'. Allow kindly Mirth into your life. Lift the pantomime chains! Look forward, away from dogma to Divine Intelligence. Through me, the great raw powers of creation are developed into those skilful Arts by which blissful Love, culture and civilisation flourish upon the Earth.'

cards.name: The Tower
cards.up: 'I am the White Queen, inner Alchemy of the Tower, 'House of God', 'Lord of the Hosts of the Mighty'. I come that your ambition for Light may grow, giving courage to be healed, made open, 're-storied'.I am Artisan of the Active or Exciting Intelligence, through which 'every existent being receives its spirit and motion'. I stir-up activity, producing transformative changes. All Venus-Mercury experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. I bring Creation's lightning-flash down towards form, crossing the upward impulse of the middle pillar, to establish the great 'Crossroads Tower of the Personality'. As radiant White Queen, I am the inner vision of that Tower. Under Mercurial skies, my great teaching project unfolds; to topple ego's babel of voices, re-building finer structures for the growing Light of Self-knowledge.Dear Alchemist, mine are the Liberal, liberating Arts, which give you power to free yourself from incarceration in outworn ideas. Dynamic as Mars, I increase the power of the Fire's heat on the Earth, 'so that its congealed part is dissolved and made bright'. Call-in those fiery rays of Wisdom and eternal illumination. Dare to give voice to new, more radiant philosophy. House my Divine Hosts with Grace.'

cards.name: The Star
cards.up: 'I am the Red King, inner alchemy of the Star, 'Daughter of the Firmament, Dweller between the Waters'. I come that your faith in the inward journey be fulfilled, transmuting hopes into gifts of Divine star-light.I am artisan of the Natural Intelligence, 'completing and perfecting' the nature of all that exists beneath the Sun. All Venus-Moon experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.I stand upon the Moon, a healed Fisher-King, dynamic inner vision of the Starry Aquarian. I 'make every earthly thing subtle', for the powerful symbols I catch come from the Grail cup of cosmos; flowing celestial waters, changing form as needed across the centuries.Dear Alchemist, travelling further will bring you to me as profoundest Star-symbol, brightest Sirius, beyond Sol's wanderers to the furthest golden sparklings of the Mystery. 'Distil seven times' to greet in turn the Seven couples holding office in the Temple of Cosmos as Pleiades and Lords of the Pole. Their starry dance opens 'the still point of the turning worlds', where, as Mithraic Priest of the Ages, I pour Rays of Love-Wisdom, in measure of the vessels you bring. Let your own 'bright particular Star' shower that Light upon the dear Earth.'

cards.name: The Moon
cards.up: 'I am the Eclipse, inner alchemy of the Moon, 'Ruler of Flux and Reflux, Child of the Sons of the Mighty'. I come that you may dream true, replacing self-deception with bright visions of change.I am Artisan of the Corporeal Intelligence, a consciousness 'forming each body' throughout Creation, and 'the reproduction of them'. All Venus-Earth experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.I am the Moon's inward vision of rising in perfect alignment between Earth and Sun, invoking the mysteries of Eclipse. My Piscean waters bring thus-darkened subtle earth to the dream-like transparency of the alchemical solutio. Deep-down instinctual powers are revealed, moved by the animate, occulting Moon, who yet wears the Sun's golden Crown.Dear Alchemist, every physical cell is touched by my powers. They work from the hidden side of things, for like 'the back of the head', they are seen only when mirrored into images. Here, where 'one nature rules another, without hurt or pause', my healing operation of Sleep nightly dissolves mundane consciousness into the dream.Prepare well for sleep. The Moon will teach lucidity, bringing you to my Treasure-house as an Adept, able to release images from illusion into their True and beautiful forms.'

cards.name: The Sun
cards.up: 'I am Child's Play, inner alchemy of the Sun, 'Lord of the Fire of the World'. I come that you may experience life's generosity, enjoying glory and riches in all worlds with the same ease as a loved child plays among friends.I am Artisan of the Collecting Intelligence, a gathering for all within the Zodiac circle of the fixed stars. All Mercury-Moon experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path.I am the inner vision of the Child of the Sun, delightedly heading Sol's annual procession through the garden of Cosmos. Through me 'Lady Astrologia' operates her liberating Art, bringing Light from the twelve starry palaces Above to illumine matters in the twelve terrestrial houses Below.Dear Alchemist, these are Mysteries of the many-coloured alchemical Coagulatio. Safe in the nursery of the Higher consciousness, presided over by the Mother, Mercurial Spirit comes from the Waters to receive new body and substance.In the play of the Elements, all has a voice, a face, a name. Personality is illumined, and can be trusted, for the higher powers care for the lower. Rejoice in this stage of your work, for old sterility is vanquished and all is fruitful once more.'

cards.name: Judgement
cards.up: 'I am Women's Work, inner alchemy of Judgement, 'Spirit of the Primal Fire'. I bring you power to follow an inspiring vision, making good decisions that transform the pattern of your life, lifting the mundane into the marvellous.I am Artisan of the Perpetual Intelligence, regulating the motions of Sun and Moon 'in their proper order'. All Mercury-Earth experiences in the Four Worlds are woven into my Alchemical path. I am the inner vision of those called to awaken by 'the Angel out ahead', eternal horizon of aspiration. I summon the sleeper to realisation of life's sacred ritual, incandescent ground of every simple act. Know me as a Holy Fire, generating the Alchemical Sublimatio, for by my Works, 'moisture is given up to the transforming vapours of the air', rising above the Earth as 'the Spirit of the Quintessence, proximate matter to the stone of the wise'.Dear Alchemist, do not be deceived by outward convention! In the skilled hands of the Adept, daily practice becomes one with the eternal round Above. By gradual cleansing of motive and means, pure Mithraic Light 'shines-through' with increasing power. Align your tasks with the highest truths of Spirit. They will bring consciousness of everlastingness beyond all Time.'

cards.name: The World
cards.up: 'I am Mithralya, promise of the Royal Land attained, inner alchemy of the World, 'Great One of the Night of Time'. I come that you may gather first-hand experience of exalted consciousness, blending all into a new 'Composition'.I am Artisan of the Administrative Intelligence, 'directing and associating' in all their operations 'the seven planets each in their own due course'. All Moon-Earth experience in the Four Worlds is woven into my Alchemical path. I complete the downward rush of Creation's Lightning Flash, enabling Earth to receive gifts from all worlds.I am the radiant inner vision of the cosmic Dancer, Glory of Shekinah, 'palace of holiness in the midst'. Like mother Saturn, she is pivot and centre of the directing powers of the whole. But her time is not yet come, and I am her sustaining vision of the Holy City, all alchemised by Mithraic Light, Heart-to-be of the Royal Land.Dear Alchemist, see how my Animate Red Sun descends to be wed with the dear Earth. It is within Mithralya as within the Self. Through their Union you too will be an 'Artisan of consciousness', playing the harmonies of the Seven Starry Wanderers unto a new octave of 'Meeting In The Heart's Radiant Awareness.''

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring the Point of Living Fire, inner alchemy of the Ace of Wands. I come that a new Archetypal Power may enter your life. A hidden treasure within longs to be known, and a Loving Divinity is all about you.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Divine Composition of Living Fire's Great Praise, the First Fire. At Spirit's Crown, incandescent source of all Mithralya's High Heavens, the first degree of Eternity comes forth from Limitless Light. Within the Flame of this Spirit-substance dwell Divine Mind's deepest patterns, as Unifying Deity, Archetype-Living Power known by many names; the Good, All-Creator, Divine Architect-Composer, the One ('Al-Lah'), Ground of Being.Dear Alchemist, Live within Unifying Awareness! Seek communion with the One Light. Be as a sunlit speck within that glorious sunrise, and the illuminating warmth of the all-inclusive will bring you the Spiritual experience of Unity. My Alchemy of the First Fire gathers into the vessel the most exalted potentials for spiritual awareness. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Brilliance. The Root of the Powers of Fire is re-formed and multiplied, your Spirit's Tree well-rooted in yet higher potential, extended vision, enhanced will. New and wonderful purposes are made known.'

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Zodiac Temple, inner alchemy of the Two of Wands. I come that you may be initiator of wise influence over another person or part of yourself.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Outrushing Fiery Wisdom, the Second Fire. We bring into Being the Encirclings of Mithralya's High Heavens. Boundless Space reaches to embrace Boundless Time, together becoming the Zodiac circle, from Zoe, Life. Their Spirit-substance patterns cosmos as both Vessel and Horizon/ring-pass-not. Here dwell Duality's Living Powers as Archetype-Deity Divine Ideal Wisdom, known by many names; Holy Isis receiving from the Great Composition, Lord Osiris conducting Forces onwards towards Form.Dear Alchemist, Live within the Relationships of Two-fold Awareness! Seek communion with their Ideals. When inner-outer, receiving-giving, personify as female-male, let them dancingly exchange places in each world, bringing the Spiritual experience of Meeting the Divine Face to Face. My Alchemy of the Second Fire gathers into the vessel all corruptions brought by rigidity and ignor-ance. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Pure-Soft-Blue. Distortions of 'Dominion' are re-formed into harmonious force for good. Your travels will reveal the Wisdom of the Circle; each round a wider, more exalted Truth.'

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Saturn Temple, inner alchemy of the Three of Wands. I come that hopes are realised and efforts followed by success.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Indwelling Fiery Understanding, the Third Fire. We bring into Being the Saturn sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens, 'high point of all Time'. The Infinite and the Eternal, united in desire for Life, light the flame of Divine Nature, that Forces may be patterned into ideal Forms. Within this Spirit-substance dwells Divine Maternal Power, Archetype-Deity of many names; Sekhmet-Hathor, Comforter, Shekinah/Holy-Spirit, Divine Presence and Power.Dear Alchemist, Live within the Three-fold Creative Awareness! Seek communion with Her. When opposites are reconciled in living radiance, both ephemeral and everlasting are transcended. Only then are Her Vision of Sorrow and Vision of Pure Delight equally Understood. My Alchemy of the Third Fire gathers into the vessel all distortions wrought by the limited perspective of pride and conceit. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Crimson. Blocks to 'Established Strength' are re-formed into timely vision and spiritual integrity. True humility is powerful evidence that you scan a wider horizon and inhabit a larger world-view, for greatness aligns with the ever-greater.'

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Jupiter Temple, inner alchemy of the Four of Wands. I come to celebrate successful completion of your tasks, and peaceful rest after labours.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Fiery Loving-Kindness, the Fourth Fire. We bring into Being the Sovereign Jupiter Sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens. A ray of Glory and bright Blessing leaps from the High Supernals across the Abyss, lighting the flame of Mastery. Within this Spirit-substance dwells Divine Paternal Power, Archetype-Deity known by many names; Vedic Dyaus-Pitar, 'Sky-Father wedded to Mother Earth', Artificer, Ptah of Ancient Memphis, Roman 'Iuppiter', Greek Zeus-Pater, and all benevolent Paternity.Dear Alchemist, Live within the immense kindliness of Four-fold Awareness! Seek communion with Him. When the Great Work is four-square complete 'all shall merry be'. Let this powerful Light kindle the Vision of Love. My Alchemy of the Fourth Fire gathers into the vessel all unsteadiness and unready forces. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Deep-Violet. Blocks to 'Perfected Works' are re-formed into spiritual awareness, subtlety and rejoicing. Knowledge is illumined by 'Meeting In The Heart's Radiant Awareness'. Feed that Adorable Fire. Invite others to your hearth.'

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Mars Temple, inner alchemy of the Five of Wands. I come to raise awareness of how powerful energies can be used for good, not strife and quarrel.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Fire's Strength and Power, the Fifth Fire. We bring into Being the challenging Mars Sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens. From the heart of beneficence springs the Flame of self-limitation, flashing brilliance and clarity to correct any distortions of the beautiful patterns. Within this Spirit-substance dwells the Spiritual Warrior, Archetype-Deity known by many names; Great Warrior in the Chariot of Fire, Divine Surgeon, Deliverer of Souls from Hades, Leader of Heaven's Armies, Holy Awe.Dear Alchemist, Live within dynamic Five-fold Awareness! Seek communion with the Spiritual Warrior. In the Hall of Justice, meet challenges with energy and discipline, and gain the Vision of Spiritual Power. My Alchemy of the Fifth Fire gathers into the vessel all violence and unfair contest, all temper and irritation. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Bright-Orange. Problems with 'Strife' are re-formed into an outpouring of strong, helpful force. Positive changes are stimulated into awareness, old karmas overcome, the Way lit by honest laughter's cleansing powers.'

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Sun Temple, inner alchemy of the Six of Wands. I come that energy and industry lead to gain and success, avoiding strife and pride.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Fire's Beautiful Harmonies, the Sixth Fire. We bring into Being the Radiant Sun Sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens. In this self-shining middle place, pure Illumination is a steady flame. Within this Spirit-substance dwells Divine Presence, Archetype-Deity of many names; golden splendour of Ra, Helios, Apollo, Surya... Each is a radiant garment for Truth's Christed Avatars, from Age to Age 'the Mithra', binding the worlds together.Dear Alchemist, Live within the beautiful Six-fold Awareness! Seek communion with Divine Presence. In the Heart's Centre, all may meet in radiance. Aspire to the Bodhisattvas, Enlightened ones who have earned Bliss, but through the Spiritual Vision of Compassion stay to teach.My Alchemy of the Sixth Fire gathers into the vessel all the stresses, temptations and drama of great effort. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Clear-Rose-Pink. Blocks to 'Victory' are re-formed into initiatory steps, 'the pattern that connects'. Child becomes Ruler, becomes Deity, 'making sacred-sacrifice' in each life, to give more in the next.'

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Venus Temple, inner alchemy of the Seven of Wands. I come that courage and vision delight a new awareness of how to succeed in all circumstances.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Fire's Loving Victory, the Seventh Fire. We bring into Being the Bright Venus sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens. From the Heart's centre, power descends with Mercy and Grace, to house Divine passion, zeal and vitality. Within this Spirit-substance dwells Many-Rayed Light, Archetype-Deity known by many names; Goddess Nike the Winged Victory, Peaceful Ruler of Hosts, Golden Astarte, Aphrodite.Dear Alchemist, Live within the vibrant Seven-fold Awareness! Seek communion with Many-Rayed Light. Join the exaltations of Venus-inspired Mysteries; Orphic, Eleusinian, Dionysian, that the Vision of Beauty Triumphant grows strong. My Alchemy of the Seventh Fire gathers into the vessel all distrust, poor compromise, quarrel and threat. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Amber. Distortions of 'Valour' are re-formed into honour, influence and joyful enthusiasms. Goddess Venus sets initiatory tasks for Psyche-Soul, leading from false light to the eternal Lamp of Truth. Learn that practice of intensity. Let your own Psyche grow to full Partnership with immortal Love.'

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Mercury Temple, inner alchemy of the Eight of Wands. I come that you make ready for sudden new awareness and wonderful realisations.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Fire's True Glory, the Eighth Fire. We bring into Being the Brilliant Mercury Sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens. Life leaps Victoriously across, lighting the flame that bestows the delights of the mind, deep-rooted in the Supernals.Within this Spirit-substance dwells the Messenger of Splendor, Archetype-Deity known by many names; Egyptian Thoth-Ma'at, Greek 'thrice-greatest' Hermes, Roman Mercurius, patron of all Alchemy.Dear Alchemist, Live within the Reverberating octaves of Eight-fold Awareness! Seek communion with the Messenger of Splendor. As the Names and Verses that enliven Creation are re-enchanted, they will open the Vision of Splendor. My Alchemy of the Eighth Fire gathers into the vessel all untrustworthy, over-hasty forces and violent actions. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Violet-Purple. Problems with 'Swiftness' are re-formed into sure confidence and eloquence. Speak with Thoth-Ma'at. Travel to Egypt's earliest Temples, where Priestly Alchemists of Memphis teach the far origins of Mithraic Light.'

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Moon Temple, inner alchemy of the Nine of Wands. I come that Health and Power may be yours, supporting a growing awareness of Life's rich potential.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Fire's Treasure-House, the Ninth Fire. We bring into Being the Silvery Moon Sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens. Abundant Life provides a vessel firm in strength to uphold Creation. Within this Spirit-substance dwells Living Foundation, Archetype-Deity of many names; Everlasting Creative Power, Great Hecate 'triple-aspect Soul of the World', Selene, Diana, and all Moon gods and goddesses.Dear Alchemist, Live within the fullness of Nine-fold Awareness! Seek communion with Living Foundation. All the inner powers that move the heavens are patterned here, granting vision of the Machinery of the Universe. My Alchemy of the Ninth Fire gathers into the vessel all doubt and obstinacy, all icy distancing. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Indigo. Blocks to 'Great Strength' are re-formed into awareness of a tremendous steady force, the Akasa. This Ether or Sky, is Nature's hidden-consciousness, mediating between mind and matter, recording all. See to it that from Her ancient and forgotten treasures you retrieve the True, illuminating 'Ether of the Wise.''

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.up: 'I bring Living Fire of the Temple of the Royal Land, inner alchemy of the Ten of Wands. I come that generosity may triumph over withholding, and the Land be free from material oppression.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Fire's Secret Exaltation, the Tenth Fire. We bring into Being the Earth Sphere of Mithralya's High Heavens. All gifts of the Fiery Tree are gathered here. This Spirit-substance is tangible ground of Divine Promise, Archetype-Deity of Earthly powers, known by many names; Alchemy's betrothed Royal Pair, Qabalistic Adonai ha-Aretz 'each individual's potential as a King or Queen', and Adonai Melek 'each individual's Holy Guardian Angel'.Dear Alchemist, Live within the Divine Promise of Ten-fold Awareness! Seek communion with your Angel. Open the Gate within, to enjoy Knowledge and Conversation with this inner Beloved. My Alchemy of the Tenth Fire gathers into the vessel all overbearing strength, injustice and malice. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Yellow. Problems with 'Oppression' are re-formed into generous disinterested-ness and the self-sacrifice that 'makes sacred'. Walk upon this Holy ground and receive your inheritance as ruler of a Royal Land. The inner Flame will be your truest guide and companion, the Secret Fire powering all your alchemy.'

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Royal of Living Fire, inner Alchemy of the Page of Wands. I Awaken a love of life to shine upon and within you, that 'all dark chambers be illuminated'.Dear Alchemist, through me you become a conscious participant throughout the Living cosmos. I guide the Page's Courtly role helping rule the Salamanders, subtle peoples of Fire. Work with us! Join their rejoicing with humble heart, and be welcomed into the illumination of their Light.As Temple Custodian of Living Fire's Great Praise, I gather all gifts from the Tree of Living Fire. Receive them with care for they are spiritual Truths, opening new kinds of consciousness according to the attitude by which you approach. Seek genuinely and they will inspire spiritual awareness.Practise my Vital Arts! Attain degrees of alignment that make you one with the Beloved you have sought. I am the very substance of Spirit, and in my domain Archetypal forces are tangible Living Powers. I will help your awareness of they who guide your finest hopes and aspirations. To live knowingly within their radiance brings a shining glory unto your spiritual body. I will help you gain this Vitality, transforming life to immortal Gold.'

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.up: 'I am Priest Royal of Living Fire, inner alchemy of the Knight of Wands. I Awaken a noble, dynamic energy adventurously into your life's Quest.Dear Alchemist, I mediate all inspired story-telling about your body of Fire. I guide the Knight's Courtly role helping rule the Salamanders, subtle peoples of Fire. Work with us! Listen inwardly and challenge religious prejudices, intolerance and meanness. Open the way to wider horizons.As Temple Cantor of Living Fire's Great Praise, I tell the stories of the Tree of Living Fire, carrying messages between the radiant beings of your most subtle body. Through me you come to know your world of Spirit and all the inhabitants therein, named by tradition Archetypes, Deities, 'Lords of Mind'.Practise my Intuitive Arts! Learn from those 'inner-tutors' who set the compass for your spiritual unfolding. Make contact with the Highest within, then seek forms for my Bardic stories on the tongues of those who know, and in the libraries of the world's Mysteries. You will recognise them because their animating power calls you home to the longed-for places of spiritual awareness within your-self-hood. When you are lost for words of Wisdom and Understanding to aid yourself or others, I will be near to help.'

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Queen of Living Fire, inner alchemy of the Queen of Wands. I Awaken a confident power of loving-kindness into your life.Dear Alchemist, through me you gain in awareness and honour, for I bring the indwelling images of your spirit, that radiant powers invigorate your consciousness. I guide the Queen's Courtly role as ruler of Salamanders, subtle peoples of Fire. Work with us! Live vitally within the Fiery Worlds, confronting all tyrannies, dominance and revenge.As Temple Celebrant of Living Fire's Great Praise, my Throne of Flame is at the heart of the South, where the Lion roars the cub into life and Summer Festivals celebrate the harvest. I preside over all Ceremonies of the Tree of Living Fire, receiving and patterning the spiritual fires of the great Composition.Practise my Initiatory Arts! Invoke passage to new qualities of awareness. Great rituals are made from the smaller, your daily mystic practices and self-assessments, which gradually 'make space for' and 'make real' the Mysteries of Life. When your fire burns low, turn to those liberating powers glimpsed in your finest moments. I will help you enter the Temple and live well in the Light and Warmth of their evidence.'

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.up: 'I am Priest King of Living Fire, inner alchemy of the King of Wands. I Awaken an active, generous power into your life, that great ones may act on your behalf. I dwell beneath the glorious Wings of the Devic Lion-Kerub of Fire, who brings new spiritual inspiration and zeal from on High.Dear Alchemist, I mediate all 're-joining' of the broken staff, Axis Mundi, through the out-rushing Fiery Powers of the great Composition. I guide the King's Courtly role as ruler of Salamanders, responsible for all subtle peoples of Fire. Work with us! Invoke swift action, to ensure a voice for all.As Temple Conductor of Living Fire's Great Praise, I stand at the midday gate of the South, where the Sun is at Zenith, and of old, brightest Sirius rose at Summer Solstice. All Powers of the Tree of Living Fire flow through my orchestration.Practise my Incandescent Arts! You will learn to raise mystic experience to perfect pitch, and sustain exalted consciousness through the power of resolve. I come to your aid when you enter a new octave of self-awareness and must rise to meet Light upon Light. I conduct you to radiant realisations and will help you live fully within their Splendor.'

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring the Point of Starry Water, inner Alchemy of the Ace of Cups. I come that a Creative beginning flows into your life. A new light shines, and an Archangel guides your way.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Divine Composition of Starry Water's Great Praise, the First Water. At Soul's Crown, flowing source of all Mithralya's Spacious Deeps, imagination's furthest reach opens to the Star-lit Oceans of Space and Depth of Seas. Within the Wisdom symbols of this Soul-substance abide the Archangels, Highest Devas of Divine radiance.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Devic Light! Come into the presence of the Highest, Archangel Metatron, Voice of the Divine. As 'source of illumination of all the Lights of the Universe', Metatron is a Mithra figure, robed in 'all the stars you can see', yet intimately the Friend, filling the thirsty traveller's cup with new meanings.My Alchemy of the First Water gathers into the vessel the most profound potentials of the Symbolic Life. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Pure-White-Brilliance. The Root of the Powers of Water is re-formed, and multiplied, bringing new beauty, pleasure and happiness into your life. Your Soul's Tree receives ever more exalted Water of Life.'

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Zodiac Temple, inner alchemy of the Two of Cups. I come that you may enjoy the bliss of unity, washing your soul in the Dew of the Seventh Heaven.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Outrushing Watery Wisdom, the Second Water. We Create symbols of the Eternal Cycle, ever-flowing sap of the World-Tree, to fill Mithralya's Spacious Deeps with life's meaning.Within this Soul-substance abides Archangel Raziel, 'Mystery of Deity', revealed amidst the great circle of the Zodiac, who embodies the Solar deity names Ra and El.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Ra-zi-el! Read from the legendary 'Book of Secrets' bestowed when Souls leave Eden for service in the fields of Earth.My Alchemy of the Second Water gathers into the vessel all promise of the longed-for companion, all secret hopes. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Pearl-Grey. Incomplete 'Love' is re-formed into a fully Loving life, uniting both inner and outer worlds. Know that your loneliness is your longing for your true Self. No love from another will truly satisfy until you meet and join with your inner Beloved. But on the Way are many friends and loves to guide and help.'

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Saturn Temple, inner alchemy of the Three of Cups. I come that kindness, gladness, and plenty may be yours.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Indwelling Watery Understanding, the Third Water. We Create the Saturn experiences of Mithralya's Spacious Deeps, bringing gifts of Purpose. All Initiatory symbol-patterns arise here, uniting the Supernal Trinity in a Mother's loving arms. Abstract Space-Time becomes the myriad rich symbols of living Cosmos, made of ordered beauty.Within this Soul-substance abides Archangel Tzaphkiel, 'Divine Memory', robed in the Night Sky, holding in her hands the Book of Life.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Tzaph-ki-el! Her radiant darkness glimmers as the Great Sea, and in that depth of stillness awaits the Pearl of Grace.My Alchemy of the Third Water gathers into the vessel all troubled feelings of unworthiness or over-entitlement. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Deepest-Black. Problems of 'Abundance' are re-formed into glad and timely celebration of your Soul's merit. Each life-time adds to the star-light of Divine Memory. Be generous to others, and create an abundant future, linking Heaven and Earth with Compassionate Understanding.'

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Jupiter Temple, inner alchemy of the Four of Cups. I come that current happiness may be seen in a beneficent philosophical light.As Ambassador, I bring goodwill from Water's Loving-Kindness, the Fourth Water. We Create the Sovereign Jupiter experiences of Mithralya's Spacious Deeps. Unconditional Love, Child of the Supernals, crosses the Abyss to take form. Here arise all symbols of the Priest-Kings and their beneficent teachings; Orb, Wand, Sceptre, Shepherd's Crook, uniting religions through Mercy and Divine Love. Within this Soul-substance abides Archangel Zadkiel, 'Divine Grace', radiant with Rainbow Light in a cloudless sky.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Tzad-ki-el! Come into the Presence of the giver of Blessings. Within such Glory, mighty Love rules, and all beings rejoice. My Alchemy of the Fourth Water gathers into the vessel all acquisitiveness and contention. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Celestial-Blue. Regrets at 'Blended Pleasures' are re-formed into gracious acceptance of change. Place my symbols in the Heart's Radiant Awareness, like seeds of beautiful plants. Water them with your deep feelings. Care for them with your Love. In due season, let them go where they will. All desiring will soon be 'made Light'.'

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Mars Temple, inner alchemy of the Five of Cups. I come that any sorrows and losses in life bring charity and kindness to the fore, not treachery and ill-will.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Water's Strength and Power, the Fifth Water. We Create the challenging Mars experiences of Mithralya's Spacious Deeps. Here arise all symbols of the fight for Justice, Truth and Light, from sword to pen. Within this Soul-substance abides Archangel Khamael, Warrior of Courage, protector and Guardian of the weak, 'Who Sees Divinity'. Intense radiance shines from her Celestial symbols; fearful or blissful according to the measure of Truth within you.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Kha-ma-el! Make progress in self-realisation. By removing obstacles to the flow of grace, new inner powers will be discovered.My Alchemy of the Fifth Water gathers into the vessel all disappointments and endings, all restricted vision and old pleasures that do you ill. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Scarlet-Red. 'Loss in Pleasure', is re-formed into a generous perspective of infinite life and light. Strengths of the mature Self empower tolerance of the unexpected, and patient passion to cultivate right use of energies.'

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Sun Temple, inner alchemy of the Six of Cups. I come that pleasures successfully beginning may steadily increase.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Water's Beautiful Harmonies, the Sixth Water. We Create the enlightening Solar experiences of Divine Presence in Mithralya's Spacious Deeps. Here arise all Symbols of harmonious relationships and Light, for this 'middle of the Middle Way' is Life's Heart-centre and Grail. As Child of powers Above, and Sovereign of forms Below, meaning is constantly revealed and made sacred in the exchange of perspectives.Within this soul-substance abides Archangel Raphael, 'Healing Power of the Divine', in whose dawn radiance shine all beings of Light and Stars.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Ra-pha-el! Be open to Beauty's power to restore unity of Being.My Alchemy of the Sixth Water gathers into the vessel all unwarranted self-assertion, vanity and contention. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Golden-Yellow. 'Pleasures' grown selfish are re-formed into Self-knowledge, appropriate wishes, and the enjoyment of success. Place water to be blessed by sunlight. Sip at dawn, to enhance your sensitivity, and begin the day with harmonious alignments.'

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Venus Temple, inner alchemy of the Seven of Cups. I come that you may travel to more profound regions of symbol, beyond the veils of illusion.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Water's Loving Victory, the Seventh Water. We Create the Bright Venus experiences of Many-Rayed Light in Mithralya's Spacious Deeps. Here in the secret garden of the soul, all symbols arise fresh with sacred dew; the Rose, Peacock's tail, lustres of lamp-light from Holy Oil, the girdle unbinding goddess Nature's full beauty. Within this soul-substance abides Archangel Haniel, 'Glory and Grace of the Divine Light'. As Divine Muse, she is guide, opening the Way.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Han-i-el! Know her Light as illumination and spiritual passion. Receive the alchemical secret that Venus is 'our subject', opened into philosophic being only by the Secret Fire that is Water. My Alchemy of the Seventh Water gathers into the vessel all self-deception and emotional pre-occupation in the personal 'sea of troubles'. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Emerald. 'Illusory Success' is re-formed into freedom from fantasy, repetition and compulsion. Inner images are crafted anew as True symbols, receiving spiritual forces of zeal, love and harmony.'

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Mercury Temple, inner alchemy of the Eight of Cups. I come that you may distinguish the shallows from the deeps, and be ready to move through many stages on the Way to the clear Light.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Water's True Glory, the Eighth Water. We Create the Brilliant Mercurial experiences of the Messenger of Splendor in Mithralya's Spacious Deeps. Here in the secret library of the soul, House of the Alchemist, all imaginal languages are cherished for their alphabets of symbol; Names and Chants, Books and Scrolls, great Principles and Lessons sent from on High. All are resplendent with the 'Azoth' Light of Nature.Within this Soul-substance abides Archangel Michael, 'Leader from Darkness', whose name is a question asking, 'Who is like Deity?'Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Mi-cha-el! Be led onward, from one Truth to another, each finer than the last.My Alchemy of the Eighth Water gathers into the vessel all restlessness, discontent and disinterest. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Orange. 'Abandoned Success' is re-formed into a quickening of the mind to larger vision. Divine longing calls the Soul ever onward to a more sublime Glory.'

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Moon Temple, inner alchemy of the Nine of Cups. I come that wishes be fulfilled, giving pleasure and complete success.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Water's Treasure-House, the Ninth Water. We Create the Silvery Moon experiences which are the Living Foundation of Mithralya's Spacious Deeps. Here is the very matter of magic; power to enliven images into starry symbols, redolent with that vital meaning which ensures a happy, fulfilled life. Like Mythic Atlas, or the fabulous 'Man in the Moon', beautiful, strong, naked, my Treasure-house upholds the world. Within this symbol-substance abides Archangel Gabriel, 'Strength of the Divine', whose messages bring the tidings of great Joy.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Gab-ri-el! She will fill your Cup, and reveal the secrets of the Mountains of the Moon. My Alchemy of the Ninth Water gathers into the vessel all poor, impulsive choice of corrupt images, all superficiality and conceit. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Violet. Problems of 'Material Happiness' are re-formed into measured and reflective choices of finest quality. Kindly self-discipline, inspired by the Higher Mind, engenders True knowledge of 'what to wish for', and how to enjoy it to the full.'

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.up: 'I bring Starry Water of the Temple of the Royal Land, inner alchemy of the Ten of Cups. I come that lasting success may make peace and happiness in your life.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Water's Secret Exaltation, the Tenth Water. In this fullest Expression of Mithralya's Spacious Deeps are gathered all gifts of the World-Tree, creating a never-failing fountain of symbols, continually giving themselves to deeper meanings. This symbol-substance is tangible ground for the Radiant Presence of Archangel Sandalphon, twin sister to Metatron on High. Together they are the 'Brotherly-Sisterly One', uniting in the middle, Mithraic Place.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Sandalphon! Let your feelings be washed clean of debris, to receive abundant life. She will gather your prayers into perfect symbols, weaving them into crowning garlands, and casting them gracefully upon the Waters that flow unto the Throne of the most High. My Alchemy of the Tenth Water gathers into the vessel all pleasures dissipated or wasted. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Citrine-Olive-Russet-Black. Blocks to 'Perfected Success' are re-formed into a generous, permanent happiness from Above. The meaning-less is no more, for Truth, ever-becoming, unfolds 'a sweet content by night and day.'

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Royal of Starry Water, inner alchemy of the Page of Cups. I Awaken imagination, poetry and courage, that dreams do not drift and dissolve, but anchor inspirations.Dear Alchemist, through me you become participant in the Symbolic life of deep feeling. I guide the Page's Courtly role helping rule Undines, subtle peoples of Water. Work with us! Cultivate inner opportunities to dwell with the Undines. Demonstrate a love of conversations that bring depth and delight, not shallow pettiness.As Temple Custodian of Starry Water's Great Praise, I gather all gifts from the Tree of Starry Water. Receive them with care, for symbols are tangible, living forces by which your life deepens into meaning, or feels flat and meaningless.Practise my Inward Arts! 'Feel-into' the symbols, releasing their profound powers. Be cleansed by the Waters at the Temple door, that your heart may recognise the bright symbols best for you. Dare to reach for them as to a beloved. I am the very substance of symbol, supporting the passion and patience you need to create wonderful connections. Practise these feelings, and they will shine around you as the myriad stars of the astral light. I will help them become real for you.'

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.up: 'I am Priest Royal of Starry Water, inner alchemy of the Knight of Cups. I Awaken your Quest for the symbols that will live for you in storied deeps, illuminating your starry, astral body.Dear Alchemist, I mediate all story-telling that Creates visions of hope, meaning and purpose. I guide the Knight's Courtly role helping rule Undines, subtle peoples of Water. Work with us! Learn to listen well, for their kindly songs guide dried and broken images back into the deep oceans to be healed. Sea-changed, their Mysteries come alive for you once more.As Temple Cantor of Starry Water's Great Praise, I tell the stories of the Tree of Starry Water, carrying messages across the inner oceans of space and stars that are your symbolic life. Through me you will know the deeps and live more fully.Practise my Questing Arts! Live as a seeker. With this thirst, life is no dull march of events. Each is revisited, deepened, and linked as episodes in a larger life-giving mythos. I am with you as you travel into the Holy symbols. I know the way inside the image, names of the guardians, all riddles and passwords to the treasure. I will help you find your way.'

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Queen of Starry Water, inner alchemy of the Queen of Cups. I Awaken gracious inner perceptions filling your soul with light and hope. I dwell beneath the glorious Wings of the Devic Eagle-Kerub of Water, who brings new meanings from the deeps.Dear Alchemist, through me you receive Waters of life, creating the indwelling images of your deep soul. I guide the Queen's Courtly role as ruler of Undines, subtle peoples of Water. Work with us! Honour their beautifully patterned songs of circling chant and response, that all feel welcomed home.As Temple Celebrant of Starry Water's Great Praise, my Throne is at the heart of the West, where the Eagle flies over darkling seas to the Hesperides, and Autumn festivals celebrate the Starry Pleiades on high. I preside over all Ceremonies of the Tree of Starry Water, receiving and patterning the soul of the great Composition.Practise my Timeless Arts! Enter living poetry in the cycles of the eternal return. My Celebrations bring joyful meaning to your ritual of Life, extending into spaciousness, yet filling the empty cup with pure tranquility. I will help you listen deeply, communing with symbols that connect the mundane with the marvellous.'

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.up: 'I am Priest King of Starry Water, inner alchemy of the King of Cups. I Awaken the powerfully motivating currents of the unconscious, through graceful poetic insights.Dear Alchemist, I mediate flow from the Reservoirs of all the Blessings, out-rushing Watery Powers of the great Composition. I guide the King's Courtly role as ruler of Undines, subtle peoples of Water. Work with us! Challenge both turbulence and indolent drifting. By harnessing the deep tides, all runs clear, and smooth Waters reflect Creative Star-Light afresh.As Temple Conductor of Starry Water's Great Praise, I stand at the sunset Gate of the West, the balancing Autumn Equinox. All Powers of the Tree of Starry Water flow through my orchestration.Practise my Co-Creative Arts! Unite Creator and created. I teach a dynamic humility, in service to the Living Powers as an orchestra's conductor is in service to magnificent music. The skilled Adept first aligns the little self with the greater. Bringing the inner orchestra into a unity makes straight the way for symbols to 're-present' more life-affirming meaning. I know where the great Archangelic powers dwell in glory. I will help you hear their music, and bear the wonder of their radiance.'

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring the Point of Sparkling Air, Inner Alchemy of the Ace of Swords. I come that a bright vision forms in your mind's eye. A new Story longs to be told, and radiant Messengers guide your way.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Divine Composition of Sparkling Air's Great Praise, the First Air. At Thought's Crown, first out-breathing of all Mithralya's Cultured Cities, ideas meet their horizon, and all stories begin.
