In this Story-substance live the radiant Devas-Angels, Peoples of the Divine Intelligences, whose 'sWords' are messages Forming sublime thoughts. First are the Chaioth ha-Qadesh, Holy Living Creatures, 'sWords' of Divine Admirable Intelligence bringing 'comprehension of the First Principle'.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with their kerubic forms as Winged Lion, Eagle, Human and Bull! Awakeners know them as mystic formulae opening all the Middle Pillar. My Alchemy of the First Air gathers into the vessel the most profound potentials of storied thought. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Pure-White-Brilliance. The Root of the Powers of Air is re-formed and multiplied, and new, inspiring tales of Splendor stir the branches of your Thought's Tree. Virtues named Attainment will come to guide you; subtle Beings who inspire Completion of the Great Work.'

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Zodiac Temple, inner alchemy of the Two of Swords. I come when your thoughts are inwardly quarrelling, or when you are at odds with others, that you may make and 're-story' Peace.As Ambassador, I bring goodwill from Outrushing Airy Wisdom, the Second Air. We Form thoughts of the Eternal Cycle to build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. Star-light is 'con-stellated' into Myths of bright Sol's Journeys through the Zodiacal Signs, where all seven wandering stars tell their tales. In this Story-substance live Sparkling Devas-Angels named Auphanim, who appear as whirling forces, or Wheels. They are 'sWords' of Radiant, Illuminating Intelligence, the Second Glory, Crown of Creation 'exalted above every head'.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Auphanim! Their Light is as Holy Breath of the Divine. Their gift of True Prophecy is cultivated by the Wise as a subtle power behind each earthly breath, lifting it to Light. My Alchemy of the Second Air gathers into the vessel all sacrifices prompted by nobility of character. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Iridescent-Pearl-Grey. They re-form as 'Peace Restored', bringing strength, justice and Truth. The Virtues named Devotions will share their Powers, opening new vistas of awareness.'

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Saturn Temple, inner alchemy of the Three of Swords. I come that you keep faith and honesty when sorrows are remembered or experienced anew, receiving fresh Understanding.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Indwelling Airy Understanding, the Third Air. We Form the Saturnine thoughts helping build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. All Saturn's Liberating Art is here, in Lady Astrologia's gracious alchemy of the Stars, revealing Time's celestial mysteries. In this Story-substance live Devas-Angels named Aralim, Thrones. They are 'sWords' of Holy Sanctifying Intelligence, 'Creating Faith' as an inspiring theory to test. They help Time's Initiations provide the evidence you need, becoming a firm Foundation for Wisdom.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Aralim! They are Mighty, but their Presence is gentle and all-enduring, and they are generous in their aid. My Alchemy of the Third Air gathers into the vessel all tears, and the clinging Vices of Avarice. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Dark-Brown. 'Sorrows' are re-formed into helpful memories, fertile ground of new life to come. The Virtues named Silences will be with you, stilling all griefs with a gently smiling finger to the lips. Love's Initiation comes only in that stillness.'

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Jupiter Temple, inner alchemy of the Four of Swords. I come that you may choose change for the better, with increase of compassion and sensitivity.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Air's Loving-Kindness, the Fourth Air. We Form the Jovial thoughts helping build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. All Jupiter's Liberating Art is here, the Divine Geometer's Golden Section producing perfect proportion in all things. In this Story-substance live the radiant Chasmalim, Brilliant Ones, the Devas-Angels Order of Dominions. They are 'sWords' of Receptive Intelligence, 'voices in silence' ruling thought with kindness and benevolence.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Chasmalim! Their Holy Powers emanate 'all the spiritual virtues with the most exalted essences'.My Alchemy of the Fourth Air gathers into the vessel all struggles, and anxieties, offspring of the noisy Vices of Excess, hypocrisy and tyranny. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Deep-Purple. They re-form as 'Rest from Strife', bringing peace, relaxation and plenty. The Virtues named Obedience will come gracefully alongside you, easing your alignment with patterns of Mastery. Breathing Jupiter's Air, stories of a loving life will illumine your thoughts.'

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Mars Temple, inner alchemy of the Five of Swords. I come that you may develop a strong, supple and visionary will. Quickness of thought will prune away all confusion, any setbacks but point the way to greater prospects.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Air's Strength and Power, the Fifth Air. We Form the challenging Martial thoughts helping build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. All Mars's Liberating Art is here, Music, calling Ideas into Divine harmonies of the all-powerful Word. In this Story-substance live Devas-Angels named Seraphim, Fiery Serpents. They are 'sWords' of Radical Intelligence, root of all harmonies, re-assembling into Unity that which ignor-ant abuse of forces has torn apart.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Seraphim! Hear the storied Song of the right use of Power. My Alchemy of the Fifth Air gathers into the vessel all offspring of the Vices of Cruelty and Destruction, all abuses of power and ill-will that accompany change. Our Arts dissolve and transform these, with tincture of Bright-Scarlet. 'Defeat' is re-formed into New Vision and confidence. Virtues named Energy and Courage will companion you in each challenge, uniting desire and endeavour into operative resolve.'

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Sun Temple, inner alchemy of the Six of Swords. I come that you may choose to enjoy a well-earned success.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Air's Beautiful Harmonies, the Sixth Air. We Form the radiant Solar thoughts helping build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. All the Sun's Liberating Art is here, Sacred Number, under Pythagorean mastery, enhancing mere quantity with vibrant qualities. In this Story-substance live Devas-Angels named Malachim, Royal messengers. They are 'sWords' of Mediating Intelligence, whose actions cause an influence to flow 'into all the reservoirs of blessings'.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Malachim! As Divine intuitions, they will enlighten consciousness of transcendent powers. My Alchemy of the Sixth Air gathers into the vessel all the myths and stories of your long travails towards the goal, all offspring of the Vices of Pride, insincerity and lack of confidence. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Rich-Salmon-Pink. 'Earned Success' re-forms, enhanced into tangible evidence your success is well-deserved. With the Virtues named Dedication to the Great Work as your guides, dignity and self-determination will grow to their proper measure.'

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Venus Temple, inner alchemy of the Seven of Swords. I come that you may find rhythm and persistence in your creative life, the unpredictable becoming firm success.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Air's Loving Victory, the Seventh Air. We Form the Bright Venus thoughts helping build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. All Venus's Liberating Art is here, in persuasive, poetic speech and story of Many-Rayed Light. In this Story-substance live Devas-Angels named Elohim, Divinities, or Principalities. They are 'sWords' of Occult or Hidden Intelligence, a radiance 'illuminating the transcendent powers seen with the mind's eye and the reverie of faith'.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Elohim! Through their alchemical recipe find the True Name of each thing, that all Creation be loved.My Alchemy of the Seventh Air gathers into the vessel all offspring of the Vices of exaggerated Waste, unreliable ebb and flow, all disrespect of your true creative powers. Our Arts dissolve and transform these, with tincture of Bright-Yellow-Green. 'Unstable Effort' is re-formed into sustained patterns of poetic intensity. Welcome the Virtues named Unselfishness as a golden thread in the stories you tell yourself of your life. Their Presence will be an ever-steadying Light.'

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Mercury Temple, inner alchemy of the Eight of Swords. I come that you may be done with over-analysing and standing in your own light, freeing yourself to think with clarity upon wiser, more generous ideas.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Air's True Glory, the Eighth Air. We Form the Brilliant Mercurial thoughts helping build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. All Mercury's Liberating Art is here, transcendent Logic, Logos of the far-travelling Messenger of Splendor. In this Story-substance live Devas-Angels named Beni Elohim, Sons of the Divine. As 'sWords' of Absolute or Perfect Intelligence, they bring clarity from far above, for 'their proper essence' emanates from the 'hidden places' of the Sky Father.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Beni Elohim! No matter how tangled the story, they can return it to its source, releasing the trapped Glory from its corruption.My Alchemy of the Eighth Air gathers into the vessel all offspring of the Vices of Falsehood, idle curiosity, and confused self-binding. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Russet-Red. 'Shortened Force' is re-formed into kindly self-acceptance and the clarity of wider horizons. The Virtues named Truthfulness will come to guide your new steps.'

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Moon Temple, inner alchemy of the Nine of Swords. I come to help you strengthen your craftworking skills amongst the substances of thought and dream.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Air's Treasure-House, the Ninth Air. We Form the Silvery Moon thoughts helping build Mithralya's Cultured Cities. All the Moon's Liberating Art is here, Grammarye, magic's grammar, patterning multitudes of correspondences into the Living Foundation from which stories of all kinds are formed.In this story-substance live Devas-Angels named Kerubim, the Strong. As 'sWords' of Pure Intelligence, they 'purify the emanations' and 'correct the design of their representations'.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Kerubim! Let their Mithraic Light shine through.My Alchemy of the Ninth Air gathers into the vessel all oppressive, ill-formed stories, all Vices of idle or Cruel thought-habits that twist your own 'sWords' against you. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Very-Dark-Purple. 'Despairing Thought' is re-formed into powerful insights, fine quality dreams, and helpful new thought-habits. Virtues named Strength will support new and skilful powers of thought-craft.'

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.up: 'I bring Sparkling Air of the Temple of the Royal Land, inner alchemy of the Ten of Swords. I come that undisciplined warring forces may yield to informed thought and the eloquence of mirth.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Air's Secret Exaltation, the Tenth Air. In this fullest Expression of all Mithralya's Cultured Cities, Storied-thought crystallises into its most tangible Forms, powerful for good or ill. All gifts of the Airy Tree are gathered here. This story-substance is the land of Devas-Angels named Ashim, Flames of Fire. As 'sWords' of Resplendent Intelligence, they are 'exalted over every head'.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Ashim! Their mindful Presence unites Below with Above, 'illuminating the Splendors of all the Lights'.My Alchemy of the Tenth Air gathers into the vessel all offspring of the toxic Vices of Avarice and Inertia, all self-undoing through 'sWords' which 'stab you in the back' with stories of failure. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Citrine-Olive-Russet-and-Black-flecked-Gold. 'Ruinous Thought' is re-formed into health-giving insights and gallant allegories. Practise the fine art of giving Praise. Smile wryly at 'thought's healing acupuncture', and Virtues named Discernment will obtain substance to walk with you rejoicing.'

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Royal of Sparkling Air, inner alchemy of the Page of Swords. I Awaken your wise and subtle thoughts, that you choose dexterously amongst the substances of the many-storied world, avoiding careless harm to yourself or others.Dear Alchemist, through me you become participant in the world of Thought. I guide the Page's Courtly role helping rule the Sylphs, subtle peoples of Air. Work with us! Elevate all converse to bring openness and clarity, not confusion.As Temple Custodian of Sparkling Air's Great Praise, I gather all gifts from the Tree of Sparkling Air. Receive with care the powerful mind-stuff of storied thought, for words are indeed 'sWords' which can cleave the way or cut and kill. You stand or fall upon your stories, so form them well.Practise my Thought-Forming Arts! Discover your power to shape thought with clarity and fine perceptions, attracting life-affirming ideas to live within them. I am the very substance of story, the golden thread by which all tales unfold. I will help you explore your 'House of Thought', for untold rooms are yet to be discovered. I have care of many Goodly thoughts whose power can heal and help. I will bring them to your mind.'

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.up: 'I am Priest Royal of Sparkling Air, inner alchemy of the Knight of Swords. I Awaken a richness of thoughts and ideas, and am firm in friendship. I dwell beneath the glorious wings of the Devic Kerub of Air, Human-faced, who brings new names and thoughts for Aquarian times.Dear Alchemist, I mediate all 'storying and re-storying' that forms your body of Thought. I guide the Knight's Courtly role helping rule the Sylphs, subtle peoples of Air. Work with us! Generate thoughtful conversations. Make opportunities to choose the initiate's path, where Good Thought shapes Good Word unto Good Deed.As Temple Cantor of Sparkling Air's Great Praise, I tell the tales of the Tree of Sparkling Air, travelling with Daimons who personify life's 'Quest-ions'. Through me you come to know thought's messengers, the Devas-Angels.Practise my Liberating Arts! Bring hermetic studies to in-form your path. Ambassadors of the seven wandering Stars will aid your discoveries of their names and natures. When you are attuned, you will know your thought body to be an offshoot of Divine Mind. I will help you choose well the 'tales you tell yourself about yourself', that they bring you to your own domain and the Light of the Friend.'

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Queen of Sparkling Air, inner alchemy of the Queen of Swords. I Awaken keen observation and perceptions that transcend illusion. Your thoughts will sweep aside dull deceptions, revealing the fine colours within, radiant with the true symbols they are clothing.Dear Alchemist, through me sublime vision enters your thinking. I guide the Queen's Courtly role as ruler of Sylphs, subtle peoples of Air. Work with us! Receive inspiring vision of bright Daimons, leading thought high above the clouds. As Temple Celebrant of Sparkling Air's Great Praise, my Throne is at the heart of the East, where the great Aquarian calls for new kinds of thought, and Spring festivals celebrate the alchemical Dews of May. I preside over all Ceremonies of the Sparkling Air, receiving and patterning the formative mind-force of the great Composition.Practise my Visionary Arts! Awaken thoughts of the Beautiful and True. Cultivate their presence and they will be your frequent guests. Sustain your vision and they will stay and serve you well, becoming the living beings of Good habit. Each moment of time has its attendant Daimon. Beneath the drab garb of poorly-crafted habits awaits the 'dearest freshness'. I will help your re-storying, awakening 'your peoples' to their true radiant status.'

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.up: 'I am Priest King of Sparkling Air, inner Alchemy of the King of Swords. I Awaken the activating force behind the world of Ideas, with subtleness and craft.Dear Alchemist, I mediate the formation of thought and speech as 'sWords' of Truth, out-rushing Airy Powers of the great Composition. I guide the King's Courtly role as ruler of Sylphs, subtle peoples of Air. Work with us! Challenge any manipulative deceits with courage and skill.As Temple Conductor of Sparkling Air's Great Praise, I stand at the sunrise gate of the East, where of old all Alchemy begins at the Spring Equinox. All Powers of the Tree of Sparkling Air flow through my orchestration.Practise my Cosmopolitan Arts! Experience how the varied languages of the imaginal are brought into relationship. All esoteric thought is here. Alchemical play with sounds and meanings reveals hidden transformative potentials, and raises thought to clarity and power exquisite as a dawn chorus. I come to your aid when old ways of thinking separate you from these inspirations. Let each out-breath clear the Way, and each in-breath welcome the wider Air of sublime Ideas and their transcendent possibilities. I will help you breathe this magic.'

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring the Point of Golden Earth, Inner Alchemy of the Ace of Pentacles. I come as a fulfilment and a new beginning. Bright Spirit will be made Material and find new Expressions in your earthly life.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Divine Composition of Golden Earth's Great Praise, the First Earth. At Earth's Crown, first establishment of all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, subtle substance overlaps with the world of manifest splendors. Here the 'First Swirlings' that are the starry Milky Way, correspond with subtle centres at the Crown of your head.The peoples of Light and Stars in this garden of Cosmos, are Virgin Spirits, 'they who have chosen', whose flame is yet to unfold.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with your True Self! Discover that you, and all present-day humanity, are those very Spirits, clothed in time's Four Elements.My Alchemy of the First Earth gathers into the vessel the most profound potentials for establishing 'what matters' in your physical life. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of White-flecked-Gold. 'The Root of the Powers of Earth' is re-formed and multiplied, making tangible what was once only dreamed. Your Material Tree will unite Life and Knowledge, bringing forth fruits unnumbered.'

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Zodiac Temple, inner alchemy of the Two of Pentacles. I come that material opposites in your life be brought into profound relationship.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Outrushing Earthly Wisdom, the Second Earth. Ours is the Zodiac's material Expression, embracing all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes. Twelve Radiant star-patterns keep vigil for the dear Earth's unfolding. As Palaces on High, each is visited in Sol's annual progress, the whole reflected down to Earth, becoming twelve Houses of life's activities.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the Material Zodiac! Discover its subtle Earth as a wreath of stars about your own Temples, and know the link between Above and Below is yours to make, bringing forth 'a Splendour of Unity'. My Alchemy of the Second Earth gathers into the vessel all discontented wavering and wandering. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of White-flecked-Red-Blue-Yellow. They re-form as 'Harmonious Change', bringing dynamic rhythms and skilful alternation in time's beautiful dance. Let into your life a time of physical changes, connecting daily details with the bigger picture. A timely good fortune will guide your vision, linking palaces Above and houses Below in profound cycles of days, years and Ages.'

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Saturn Temple, inner alchemy of the Three of Pentacles. I come with news that an increase of substance is due, and great powers will help build new forms.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Indwelling Earthly Understanding, the Third Earth. We shine golden light of Saturn's material Expression over all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, displaying the great Mother and Initiator's 'Outer Robe of Concealment', garment of Light.Rays of Saturn crystallise deep in Earth's subtle Cosmos, becoming Lead, 'the sleeping giant', prime substance for the transformative Arts. Saturn upholds physical life, and teaches how to yield to the disciplines required by the great Art of Living well and wise.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Material Saturn! Be more truly present in the physical world. The great Initiator will turn leaden Time to golden, immortal moments. My Alchemy of the Third Earth gathers into the vessel all narrow, unbending visions. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Grey-flecked-Pink. They re-form into 'Material Works' made with constructive forces, devoid of selfishness or prejudice. Material disciplines become your friends, bringing gain in substance, influence and creation.'

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Jupiter Temple, inner alchemy of the Four of Pentacles. I come that you may be fully at ease and in possession of your Earthly frame, with abundance of health and power.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Earthly Loving-Kindness, the Fourth Earth. We shine benevolent Light of Jupiter's material Expression over all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, displaying the Sky Father's starry garment. Rays of Jupiter crystallise deep in Earth's subtle cosmos as lightning-bolt patterns of silvery-white Tin, the perfect alloy. Jupiter is intelligent overlord of all nutrition, promoting healthy growth and healing, expansive insights, and full participation in Life's great ritual.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Material Jupiter! Be taught by 'the Luminous Assembly', Masters of these Arts. My Alchemy of the Fourth Earth gathers into the vessel all discontents, over-blown authority and excessive vigilance. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Deep-Azure-flecked-Yellow. 'Earthly Power' is enhanced, re-forming into vibrant, generous and delighted health. When such magnificence is brought within the Truths of Divine Nature you will gain in ease and grace, becoming a perfect vessel for finer consciousness.'

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Mars Temple, inner alchemy of the Five of Pentacles. I come that you may be Earth's champion, labouring mightily on Her behalf, and gaining in stature thereby.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Earthly Strength and Power, the Fifth Earth. We shine the energetic red glow of Mars's material Expression upon all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, displaying the celestial Warrior's garment of Light. Rays of Mars crystallise deep in Earth's subtle cosmos, becoming Iron, carrier of meteoric sparks from the deeps of space. Mars corresponds physically to all that is strong, blood-red and urgent, and in subtle consciousness teaches how to raise and manage the fires, placing powerful impulse in service to fine ideals.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Material Mars! Be in contact with that abundant vitality, and receive energetic powers to spring-clean and edit your life. My Alchemy of the Fifth Earth gathers into the vessel all poverty, toil, loss, and material fears. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Red-flecked-Black. 'Material Trouble' is overcome, re-forming into the imaginative powers to challenge mere literalism. As Adept of the 'Martial Arts' of determination, you will never abandon the Just war against ignorance, exploitation and disease.'

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Sun Temple, inner alchemy of the Six of Pentacles. I come that Radiant Beauty may be welcomed to your life, enhancing it with sure success and worthy confidence in material achievements.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Earth's Beautiful Harmonies, the Sixth Earth. We shine Sol's material Expression, Light of Day, upon all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, displaying the radiant garment of Divine Presence. Rays of Sol crystallise deep in Earth's subtle cosmos, becoming Gold, incorruptible giver of Light and Life. Physically, Sol corresponds to your Heart, and its temenos, the Solar Plexus. Its spark is at the centre of every cell, organ and subtle gate, for to each can come the dawn of enlightened consciousness.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Material Sol! Open 'the eye of the heart' that perceives all harmonies. My Alchemy of the Sixth Earth gathers into the vessel all extreme judgements of self-aggrandisement or self-belittling that diminish your well-earned Truths. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Golden-Amber. 'Success in Material Things' is enhanced, re-forming into nobility of character and just, liberating attitudes. The Solar Plexus generates kindly warmth, and the illuminated Chapel of the Heart radiates philanthropic gifts to others.'

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Venus Temple, inner alchemy of the Seven of Pentacles. I come that you may undertake honourable work, not only for gain, but for Love of a higher vision.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Earth's Loving Victory, the Seventh Earth. We shine Venus's material Expression upon all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, as Bright Morning or Evening Star, displaying the radiant garment of Many-Rayed Light. Venus's rays crystallise deep in Earth's subtle cosmos becoming lustrous Copper, malleable into myriad soft hues or strong verdigris. Venus is a beloved brightness with special relationship to Earth; symbolised in the left hand and its wedding finger, and operative in subtle centres of consciousness as a regimen of fine-burning Light whose gentle heat makes welcome a winged spirit.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Material Venus! Let this Light be your vital ingredient.My Alchemy of the Seventh Earth gathers into the vessel all disappointments in the material world. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Olive-flecked-Gold. 'Success Unfulfilled' re-forms into true, embodied appreciation that nothing is wasted or lost. Cultivate a vision spanning many lifetimes, and grow yet finer fruits according to Higher principles of Love.'

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Mercury Temple, inner alchemy of the Eight of Pentacles. I come that the fine-tuned skills of the industrious artist may be yours.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Earth's True Glory, the Eighth Earth. We shine the Brilliance of Mercury's material Expression over all Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, displaying the Messenger of Splendor's garment of Light. Mercury's rays crystallise deep in Earth's subtle cosmos, becoming a potent silvery liquid; Quicksilver. Mercury is Spirit's volatile symbol, overseeing the breath and all means of communication.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Material Mercury! Reach into the subtle to receive the mercurial 'Azoth'; animating spirit hidden in matter, making possible all transmutation.My Alchemy of the Eighth Earth gathers into the vessel all excessive caution, lack of enterprise, hoarding or low cunning. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Yellowish-Black-flecked-White. 'Prudence' becomes artistic power, re-forming into right focus and the artist's dedicated attention to important detail. Wear proudly the craft-worker's apron. Absorbed in the polish and perfection of your Art, you will confidently shape the perfect forms you need.'

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Moon Temple, inner alchemy of the Nine of Pentacles. I come that the blessings of good sleep may be yours. I guide your physical repose and bring all the worlds' riches to your awakenings.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Earth's Treasure-House, the Ninth Earth. We shine the silver eye of Night upon all Mithralya's Lovely landscapes, displaying the material robe of life's Living Foundation. The Moon's rays crystallise deep in Earth's subtle cosmos, becoming Silver, sovereign reflector of visible light. Silver corresponds to the powers of generation in both material and subtle centres of consciousness, and is the inward eye of true imagination, intuition and connection.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with Material Moon! Greet Alchemy's White Queen and her gracious gifts. Learn the Art of Sleep and Dream, that Day and Night each bring you those gracious gifts.My Alchemy of the Ninth Earth gathers into the vessel all covetousness and theft of time, all exhaustion of resources. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Citrine-flecked-with-Azure. 'Material Gain' is multiplied, re-formed into profound creative rhythm, lucidity and physical delight. Treasure your good fortune. Use it to build a true and noble vision.'

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I bring Golden Earth of the Temple of the Royal Land, inner alchemy of the Ten of Pentacles. I come as a place of fulfilment, that material gain and fortune may be yours.As Ambassador, I bear goodwill from Earth's Secret Exaltation, the Tenth Earth. We bring Light to all four elements of Mithralya's Lovely Landscapes, displaying close at hand the radiant garments of the Royal Land. All Earthly gifts of the material Tree are gathered here. In this subtle-solid Earth substance dwell the Elementals; Gnomes of Earth, Sylphs of Air, Undines of Water, Salamanders of Fire.Dear Alchemist, seek communion with the material Elementals! Meet their subtle Elementals, but be guided in this by the Awakeners. Their rulership can bring all the Royal Land into harmonious accord. My Alchemy of the Tenth Earth gathers into the vessel all burdens that result when manifold goods become clutter, unwanted responsibilities, 'too much salt'. Our Arts dissolve and transform these with tincture of Black-rayed-Yellow. 'Wealth' becomes proportionate, re-forming into the gifts of a light touch and clear, charitable vision. Heights of one success become the foothills of your next project, opening new vistas for a physical life bringing 'happiness, cheerfulness and peace' for all.'

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Royal of Golden Earth, inner Alchemy of the Page of Pentacles. I Awaken your kindness, care and diligence amongst the materials of the dear Earth, that they are loved, not wasted. I dwell beneath the glorious wings of the Devic Bull-Kerub of Earth, bringing strength and stability of 'the Enduring and Beautiful'.Dear Alchemist, through me you become participant in Earthly life. I guide the Page's Courtly role helping rule the Gnomes, subtle peoples of Earth. Work with us! Demonstrate generosity, and teach them to bring wealth not woe.As Temple Custodian of Golden Earth's Great Praise, I gather all gifts from the Tree of Golden Earth. Receive with good heart these blended substances of material and subtle matter, for you are their opportunity for True Expression.Practise my Joyful Arts! Experience how the stars Above are housed Below. I am the very substance of subtle and material Earth. When your physical frame is as well cared-for as my Golden Garden, you follow the initiate's way, able to receive, cherish, and give. Attune yourself to the warmth and life all around you. I have care of many treasures hidden or lost in the dark places. I will help you find them.'

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I am Priest Royal of Golden Earth, inner alchemy of the Knight of Pentacles. I Awaken steady, helpful increase in your airy exchanges within the dear Earth, that good rhythms replace any thoughtless haste, unfolding new alignments.Dear Alchemist, I mediate the rhythms of your sensation body. I guide the Knight's Courtly role helping rule the Gnomes, subtle peoples of Earth. Work with us! Elevate conversations away from hurried impatience. Make speech into music.As Temple Cantor of Golden Earth's Great Praise, I tell the Stories of the Tree of Golden Earth, travelling the seasons on your subtle and physical breathings.Practise my Rhythmic Arts! Experience how the mundane unites with the celestial. Physical breathing can be as the Divine inhalations and exhalations, received in measure according to capacity. Concentrate upon the breath as a sparkling fountain of Mithraic Light flowing 'outward and downward' all around you. Pause, receiving from Below. Draw 'inward and upward' through your centre. Pause, receiving from Above. Fountain the Light once more. A well-shaped traditional rhythm counts 'out4—pause2—in4—pause2', amplifying inner vision. Discover how that which powers the voice also brings the worlds into being. I will guide you along this 'way and level road'.'

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I am Priestess Queen of Golden Earth, inner alchemy of the Queen of Pentacles. I Awaken you to Life's feast, celebrating generosity, opulence and a warm sense of interconnectedness.Dear Alchemist, through me you are welcomed to a rich heritage. I guide the Queen's Courtly role as ruler of Gnomes, subtle peoples of Earth. Work with us! Make them kindly invitations, for welcomed visitors to daily life bring their treasures happily to your door.As Temple Celebrant of Golden Earth's Great Praise, my Throne is at the heart of the North, where the Winged Bull brings legacy of 'the Enduring and Beautiful'. Here, Winter festivals celebrate the Dark Mother of silences, then welcome the White Mother of the new-born Sun's first days. I preside over all Ceremonies of the Golden Earth, receiving and patterning substances of the great Composition.Practise my Contemplative Arts! Time's duration acquires intensity, each attended moment deepening to spacious presence. I mediate the great Earthly powers, that in time you may truly 'remember' your material body is a Temple, containing every power and splendor of the larger macrocosm. I can teach you true 'con-templa-tion', for it means 'to bring temples together', and will unite Above and Below in your own lived experience.'

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.up: 'I am Priest King of Golden Earth, inner Alchemy of the King of Pentacles. I Awaken the fires of Earth, and am the very essence of the energy underlying Earthly growth.Dear Alchemist, I mediate the life-force of your physical frame, the out-rushing Earthly Powers of the great Composition. I guide the King's Courtly role as ruler of the Gnomes, subtle peoples of Earth. Work with us! Challenge greed or dullness, bringing clever, patient endeavour.As Temple Conductor of Golden Earth's Great Praise, I stand at the Midnight gate of the North, Winter Solstice, where of old the heralding Star of the Christed One shines forth. All Powers of the Tree of Golden Earth flow through my orchestration.Practise my Participative Arts! Be drawn into connection and inner community. When life weighs heavy, or you feel coldly distant, I will help you recognise and unite with the Light and Warmth at the centre of things. Know that all is life-spirit in differing rates of vibration, warmed and illumined by the same Fires. All has a face, a voice, a name, perceived according to the quality of consciousness you have awakened. I can introduce you, opening subtle centres that give incarnate body to this life-giving knowledge.'

cards.name: The Fool
cards.up: Reckless leap with zero plan — thrilling right up until you hit the ground. Naivety dressed up as freedom.
cards.rev: You've been played for a fool, or you're about to be. Stop ignoring the red flags.

cards.name: The Magician
cards.up: You have every tool you need — the only thing stopping you is your own excuses.
cards.rev: Manipulative, all talk. Someone (maybe you) is bullshitting their way through this.

cards.name: The High Priestess
cards.up: Your gut already knows the answer. Stop asking people who know less than you do.
cards.rev: You're lying to yourself. Secrets are rotting quietly and it's catching up.

cards.name: The Empress
cards.up: Abundance, fertility, comfort — but check whether you're nurturing something or smothering it.
cards.rev: Neglect, burnout, or an unhealthy dependence. Something (or someone) is being starved of care.

cards.name: The Emperor
cards.up: Control and structure that actually work. Don't mistake rigidity for strength.
cards.rev: A control freak running the show into the ground. Ego over sense.

cards.name: The Hierophant
cards.up: Tradition and rules exist for a reason — follow the system this once.
cards.rev: Blind conformity or hollow rebellion for its own sake. Neither is actually thinking for yourself.

cards.name: The Lovers
cards.up: A real choice, a real bond — but it demands you actually show up for it.
cards.rev: A relationship built on convenience, imbalance, or flat-out incompatibility. Wake up.

cards.name: The Chariot
cards.up: Sheer will drags this over the line. Discipline, not luck.
cards.rev: You're steering nothing — this is chaos with your name on it. Get a grip.

cards.name: Strength
cards.up: Quiet, stubborn courage. You're stronger than the situation, even if it doesn't feel like it.
cards.rev: Self-doubt eating you alive, or you're forcing dominance instead of earning it.

cards.name: The Hermit
cards.up: Withdraw and think. Everyone else's noise is drowning out your own answer.
cards.rev: Isolation curdling into loneliness. You've disappeared and no one's noticed — including you.

cards.name: Wheel of Fortune
cards.up: Change is coming whether you're ready or not. Grip loosens, deal with it.
cards.rev: A losing streak that feels personal but isn't. Bad luck, not punishment — ride it out.

cards.name: Justice
cards.up: Consequences land exactly where they should. No shortcuts, no favours.
cards.rev: An unfair outcome, or you dodging accountability you clearly deserve.

cards.name: The Hanged Man
cards.up: Nothing moves until you stop fighting it. Surrender is the strategy here.
cards.rev: Stalling on purpose because moving forward terrifies you. Self-sabotage with a nicer name.

cards.name: Death
cards.up: Something is ending, fully, and no amount of clinging saves it. Let it die.
cards.rev: Refusing to let go of something already dead. Decay while you pretend it's fine.

cards.name: Temperance
cards.up: Balance earned through patience, not luck. Slow blending beats forcing it.
cards.rev: Excess, overcorrection, an all-or-nothing mess. You've lost the middle ground entirely.

cards.name: The Devil
cards.up: You're chained to something toxic — a habit, a person, a pattern — and you know it.
cards.rev: The chains are loosening. Waking up to how trapped you actually were.

cards.name: The Tower
cards.up: Sudden, brutal collapse of something built on a lie. It had to fall.
cards.rev: You're delaying the inevitable crash. The longer you wait, the worse the wreckage.

cards.name: The Star
cards.up: Real hope after real damage — not naive, earned. Keep going.
cards.rev: Despair, burnt-out faith, feeling forgotten. The hope's gone quiet, not gone forever.

cards.name: The Moon
cards.up: You're being deceived — maybe by someone else, maybe by your own anxiety. Trust nothing at face value.
cards.rev: The fog's clearing. A hard truth finally surfaces after a long confusion.

cards.name: The Sun
cards.up: Straightforward good fortune, no asterisks. Enjoy it without overthinking it.
cards.rev: Delayed joy, or a happiness you're faking for an audience. Check what's real.

cards.name: Judgement
cards.up: A reckoning — you're being called to answer for something, good or bad.
cards.rev: Avoiding a wake-up call you badly need. Denial isn't a plan.

cards.name: The World
cards.up: Full completion. You earned this ending — don't rush into the next thing yet.
cards.rev: Unfinished business dragging on. Loose ends you keep pretending are tied.

cards.name: Ace of Wands
cards.up: A hard, undeniable spark of ambition. Act on it now or watch it fizzle.
cards.rev: False start, or motivation you're faking. The spark isn't really there yet.

cards.name: Two of Wands
cards.up: Big plans, but you're still just staring at the map. Commit or stay stuck.
cards.rev: Fear of leaving the comfort zone is costing you the whole opportunity.

cards.name: Three of Wands
cards.up: Expansion is working — but don't get comfortable, this is only the beginning.
cards.rev: Delays and obstacles you didn't plan for. Your timeline was too optimistic.

cards.name: Four of Wands
cards.up: Genuine celebration, a milestone actually earned. Let yourself enjoy it.
cards.rev: A celebration that feels hollow, or instability under a happy surface.

cards.name: Five of Wands
cards.up: Petty conflict, everyone fighting for the sake of fighting. Exhausting and pointless.
cards.rev: Conflict avoided by burying it — it'll resurface uglier later.

cards.name: Six of Wands
cards.up: A real win, publicly earned. Take the credit, you did the work.
cards.rev: Recognition denied, or a win that turns out to be empty and short-lived.

cards.name: Seven of Wands
cards.up: You're outnumbered and defending ground that matters. Stand firm, it's worth it.
cards.rev: You're worn down and losing the fight. Know when defending becomes pointless.

cards.name: Eight of Wands
cards.up: Fast-moving momentum — things are about to happen quickly, ready or not.
cards.rev: Frustrating delays, crossed wires, communication that keeps missing.

cards.name: Nine of Wands
cards.up: Battered but not broken. One more push, even though you're exhausted.
cards.rev: Paranoid exhaustion — defending against threats that aren't even there anymore.

cards.name: Ten of Wands
cards.up: Carrying more than you should, alone, because you refuse to delegate. It's crushing you.
cards.rev: Burnout. Time to put something down before it breaks you.

cards.name: Page of Wands
cards.up: Impulsive curiosity, an idea worth chasing even half-formed.
cards.rev: All talk, no follow-through. Excitement that never becomes action.

cards.name: Knight of Wands
cards.up: Reckless, fast, impatient action. Might work, might blow up in your face.
cards.rev: Impulsiveness with no direction — burning energy on something going nowhere.

cards.name: Queen of Wands
cards.up: Confident, magnetic, unapologetically herself. Doesn't need permission.
cards.rev: Insecurity dressed up as confidence, or jealousy poisoning the room.

cards.name: King of Wands
cards.up: A leader who actually delivers on vision, not just talk.
cards.rev: Arrogance and impulsive control — leading through ego, not competence.

cards.name: Ace of Cups
cards.up: New emotional opening — real feeling, not performative. Let it in.
cards.rev: Emotional blockage, or feelings you're refusing to let yourself have.

cards.name: Two of Cups
cards.up: Genuine mutual connection. Rare — don't take it for granted.
cards.rev: A one-sided connection, or a breakup brewing under the surface.

cards.name: Three of Cups
cards.up: Real friendship worth celebrating. Community that actually shows up for you.
cards.rev: Gossip, overindulgence, or friendships that are more surface than substance.

cards.name: Four of Cups
cards.up: Apathy — you're so in your head you're missing an opportunity right in front of you.
cards.rev: Finally snapping out of the funk and noticing what's available.

cards.name: Five of Cups
cards.up: Grieving what's lost while ignoring what's still standing. Look up.
cards.rev: Starting to accept the loss and move forward, slowly.

cards.name: Six of Cups
cards.up: Nostalgia — maybe useful, maybe keeping you stuck in a past that's gone.
cards.rev: Living in the past to the point it's stunting you now.

cards.name: Seven of Cups
cards.up: Too many options, none of them examined honestly. Fantasy over reality.
cards.rev: Finally cutting through the illusions and choosing something real.

cards.name: Eight of Cups
cards.up: Walking away from something that looks fine but isn't fulfilling anymore. Trust that.
cards.rev: Staying in something you already know is dead, out of fear.

cards.name: Nine of Cups
cards.up: Genuine satisfaction — the ‘wish fulfilled’ card, actually earned.
cards.rev: Empty indulgence, satisfaction that's shallow and won't last.

cards.name: Ten of Cups
cards.up: Real, lasting emotional fulfilment. Not perfect, but genuinely good.
cards.rev: A picture-perfect image hiding real cracks underneath.

cards.name: Page of Cups
cards.up: An emotional message or idea arriving — a little naive, but sincere.
cards.rev: Emotional immaturity, moodiness, creative ideas that go nowhere.

cards.name: Knight of Cups
cards.up: A romantic offer or invitation — charming, but check if it's substance or just style.
cards.rev: Empty charm, moodiness, someone selling you a fantasy they can't deliver.

cards.name: Queen of Cups
cards.up: Deep emotional intelligence and compassion — know your limits before you drown in others' feelings.
cards.rev: Emotional manipulation, or drowning in your own feelings with no boundaries.

cards.name: King of Cups
cards.up: Emotional control — calm under pressure, feels everything but isn't ruled by it.
cards.rev: Emotional repression finally leaking out sideways, or manipulative moodiness.

cards.name: Ace of Swords
cards.up: A sharp, clarifying truth cuts through the noise. Use it.
cards.rev: Confusion, or a truth twisted into a weapon against you.

cards.name: Two of Swords
cards.up: Deliberate avoidance of a decision. You know the answer, you just hate it.
cards.rev: Forced to finally decide — the standoff can't continue.

cards.name: Three of Swords
cards.up: Brutal heartbreak. Betrayal, grief, pain with no soft edges. It hurts because it's real.
cards.rev: The wound is old but you keep reopening it. Time to actually heal.

cards.name: Four of Swords
cards.up: Forced rest. Your body or mind is shutting things down whether you agree or not.
cards.rev: Burnout from refusing to rest when you clearly needed to.

cards.name: Five of Swords
cards.up: A hollow win — you got your way and lost respect doing it.
cards.rev: Fallout from a conflict you ‘won’ too aggressively. Reputation damage.

cards.name: Six of Swords
cards.up: Moving away from a mess, slowly, painfully, but it's the right direction.
cards.rev: Stuck in transition — can't leave the wreckage behind yet.

cards.name: Seven of Swords
cards.up: Deception — someone (maybe you) cutting corners or lying to get ahead.
cards.rev: Getting caught. The scheme unravels and there's nowhere to hide.

cards.name: Eight of Swords
cards.up: Trapped by your own thinking, not by actual circumstances. The exit's right there.
cards.rev: Finally seeing you were never as stuck as you believed.

cards.name: Nine of Swords
cards.up: 3am anxiety spiralling out of control. The fear is louder than the actual threat.
cards.rev: Finally facing the thing you've been catastrophising about — relief follows.

cards.name: Ten of Swords
cards.up: Total, brutal collapse. It can't get worse than this — which means it's over.
cards.rev: Refusing to accept an ending that's already happened. Prolonging the pain.

cards.name: Page of Swords
cards.up: Sharp curiosity, maybe gossip. Watch what you say before you know the full story.
cards.rev: Reckless words causing real damage. Think before the next sentence.

cards.name: Knight of Swords
cards.up: Aggressive, fast, cutting through obstacles with no patience for consequences.
cards.rev: Recklessness that's about to blow up in your face — slow down.

cards.name: Queen of Swords
cards.up: Cold, clear-eyed honesty. She'll tell you the truth whether you want it or not.
cards.rev: Cruelty dressed as honesty. Using sharpness to hurt, not to help.

cards.name: King of Swords
cards.up: Ruthless logic — decisions made on fact, feelings be damned.
cards.rev: Cold-blooded manipulation, using intellect to dominate rather than clarify.

cards.name: Ace of Pentacles
cards.up: A real, tangible opportunity — money, a job, a foundation. Take it seriously.
cards.rev: A missed opportunity, or a financial foundation that's actually shaky.

cards.name: Two of Pentacles
cards.up: Juggling multiple demands, barely — it's manageable but only just.
cards.rev: Dropping the ball. You've overcommitted and something's about to fall apart.

cards.name: Three of Pentacles
cards.up: Solid teamwork that's actually working, skill recognised.
cards.rev: Poor teamwork, clashing egos, work sabotaged by lack of coordination.

cards.name: Four of Pentacles
cards.up: Hoarding out of fear, not need. Loosen the grip before it costs you more.
cards.rev: Financial insecurity finally forcing you to let go and spend or share.

cards.name: Five of Pentacles
cards.up: Real hardship — financial, physical, or being left out in the cold. It's rough.
cards.rev: Recovery starting after the hardship, help finally arriving.

cards.name: Six of Pentacles
cards.up: Fair exchange — help given or received without strings, for once.
cards.rev: A power imbalance in giving and receiving — charity with control attached, or exploitation.

cards.name: Seven of Pentacles
cards.up: Patiently waiting for effort to pay off. It's not wasted, it's just slow.
cards.rev: Impatience about to make you quit right before the payoff.

cards.name: Eight of Pentacles
cards.up: Grinding, skill-building, unglamorous work that's actually going somewhere.
cards.rev: Sloppy, careless effort — cutting corners that will show later.

cards.name: Nine of Pentacles
cards.up: Self-sufficient comfort, earned alone. Enjoy it without guilt.
cards.rev: Isolation dressed up as independence. The comfort's a little lonely.

cards.name: Ten of Pentacles
cards.up: Long-term security, legacy, generational stability. The big picture is solid.
cards.rev: Family money conflict, or short-term thinking wrecking long-term stability.

cards.name: Page of Pentacles
cards.up: A real, grounded opportunity to learn a new skill. Take it seriously, it compounds.
cards.rev: Procrastination, unrealistic plans, all study and no execution.

cards.name: Knight of Pentacles
cards.up: Slow, steady, unglamorous progress. Boring but it's actually working.
cards.rev: Stagnation dressed up as caution. You're not being careful, you're stuck.

cards.name: Queen of Pentacles
cards.up: Practical nurturing — comfort that's actually useful, not just performative.
cards.rev: Neglecting yourself while over-caring for everyone else. Refill your own cup.

cards.name: King of Pentacles
cards.up: Real, earned material success — generous because he can actually afford to be.
cards.rev: Greed, or success built on exploiting people under him.

cards.rev: Apathy, hesitation, a faulty choice, doldrums, recklessness
