​Magickal/historical uses: it symbolically represents the resurrection and life after death. In ancient times it was used in rituals for its euphoric and hallucinogenic properties to contact spirits.
​THE POISON
Angel has closed their mind and believes only in what they can see, hear and touch; things must be scientifically proven before given any credibility. Angel smirks when people bring up subjects such as life after death or communication with spirits because they are highly sceptical of any spiritual nonsense and believe this makes them a very intelligent and logical person. A little scepticism is healthy; outright cynicism is not. Angel shields their mind to delicious possibilities when all they really need to do is trust and open their mind to new ways of thinking.
​THE ANTIDOTE
The human body is a vehicle that we drive while on this planet. It houses the eternal soul, which continues to live on once the human host dies. This is not false hope: the survival of consciousness after physical death is close to being scientifically proven with inventions such as the SoulPhone. Angel can be open to the idea that life goes on even when the physical body doesn’t. They will awaken to this knowledge when the time is right, and it will bring them much peace and understanding.

cards.name: Boggard Posy
cards.up:
11. BOGGARD POSY
​Gossip and kindness
​Botanical name: Mercurialis perennis
​Energy: warty, wary, and acrid
​Other names: dog's mercury
​Traditional / Medicinal uses: The leaves were historically mixed with vinegar and sugar to treat warts.
​Magickal / Historical uses: Used in spells to dispel gossip. In English folklore, a boggard is a mischievous house spirit that enjoys causing minor trouble and mischief.
​The Poison: 
Represents the urge to engage in harmful gossip, exaggeration, or speculation about others for attention or entertainment, often forgetting to be kind.
​The Antidote: 
Encourages evaluating whether sharing information about someone else is truly helpful, true, or necessary. Advises practicing kindness and avoiding the spread of rumors or misinformation.

cards.name: Foxglove
cards.up:
19. FOXGLOVE
​Magickal thinking
​Botanical name: Digitalis purpurea
​Energy: strengthening, flowing, and fluid
​Other names: dead men's bells, fairy caps, witches' gloves, lady's glove
​Traditional / Medicinal uses: Modern medicine uses compounds from it to treat irregular heartbeats and fluid buildup.
​Magickal / Historical uses: Linked to folklore surrounding fairies and deep forest glades where fae reside.
​The Poison: 
Holding unrealistic expectations for oneself or others, trying to control outcomes through wishful thinking, and spiraling into frustration when life doesn't align with these ideals.
​The Antidote: 
Reminds us that while optimism and magical thinking can lighten the heart, trying to control everything leads to unnecessary stress. True peace comes from accepting that not everything is within our control.

cards.name: Black Hellebore
cards.up:
4. BLACK HELLEBORE
​Drop the drama
​Botanical name: Helleborus niger.
​Energy: narcotic, mystic and pure.
​Other names: Christ herb, Christmas rose, melampode.
​Traditional/medicinal uses: the black root was dried and powdered to treat hysteria and calm strong emotions.
​Magickal/historical uses: in folk magic, casting the powdered root into the air was thought to render a person invisible.
​THE POISON
For Hellebore strong emotions act like a narcotic: they are addicted to the drama. Hellebore lurches from self-created crisis to crisis, never really enjoying peace and calm. They centre themselves in every tragedy, enjoying the attention, and are dependent on powerful emotions to make them feel energised. If life is getting a bit dull and quiet, Hellebore will create a commotion just so they can feel alive again.
​THE ANTIDOTE
Intense emotions are something we have been gifted with to help us focus on what we want to manifest. The heady feeling of strong emotions can be addictive, and is one of our huge lessons on earth. Do not confuse passion and intensity with aliveness when these strong feelings are used to feed a habit and garner attention. Hellebore can drop the drama this time around.

cards.name: Nutmeg
cards.up:
30. NUTMEG
​Manifesting
​Botanical name: Myristica fragrans
​Energy: warming and comforting
​Other names: myristica, mace, true nutmeg
​Traditional / Medicinal uses: Used in tonics to soothe digestive issues and as a comforting spice.
​Magickal / Historical uses: Employed in spells to manifest wealth and abundance.
​The Poison: 
Feeling victimized by circumstances, misusing manifestation concepts purely for material gain (luxury items, status, wealth) without deeper connection.
​The Antidote: 
Shifting focus from immediate human longings to true soul desires. Aligning manifestation efforts with spiritual goals and the higher good for true transformation.

cards.name: Arum Lily
cards.up:
8. ARUM LILY
​Courage of convictions
​Botanical name: Zantedeschia aethiopica.
​Energy: glowing, snowy and smooth.
​Other names: calla lily, green goddess.
​Traditional/medicinal uses: the tubers were used as a South African folk remedy to topically treat wounds. They should never be ingested.
​Magickal/historical uses: they are used in spells to connect with the power of the divine feminine. They flourish quickly and are extremely resilient.
​THE POISON
The disempowered Arum lives in doubt and fear. They are constantly worried about what others will think of them or if they are doing the right thing. They are scared of being judged, cancelled and shut down for their beliefs. As a result, Arum does nothing and remains stuck, their beautiful gifts to humanity languishing and becoming atrophied. They need to practise their resilience by fully believing in themselves and standing up to the naysayers with power and grace. Arum needs to have the courage of their convictions.
​THE ANTIDOTE
Once Arum has tapped into their resilience and power, watch out: there is no stopping them! Beautiful, heart-centred determination and a willingness to make the world a better place become their life mission. They embody goddess energy, knowing who they are and that they are on earth to make a difference – and they will.

cards.name: Liberty Cap
cards.up:
​36. LIBERTY CAP
​Surrender
​Botanical name: Psilocybe semilanceata
​Energy: magickal, hidden and mysterious
​Other names: magic mushroom, blue legs, pixie caps, witches' hats
​Traditional / Medicinal uses: Promising studies show their use in micro-dose amounts combats depression, addiction and anxiety.
​Magickal / Historical uses: This magic mushroom contains the hallucinogenic substance psilocybin and is associated with super consciousness, fairies and elementals. It has been used in rituals since ancient times for prophetic visions and insights.
​The Poison: 
The disempowered Liberty Cap doesn't allow for intuition, pottering or time to dream because they want to achieve their human goals as quickly as possible. They will never give in and never give up and will keep knocking on closed doors. They have decided what their life plan is, and there is no deviating from their rigid schedule: they must stick to this plan! There is a logical progression of things to cross off their to-do list so they can be seen as successful. They are locked in their own minds, trying to use willpower and force to create things and not allowing for creativity, insight or new experiences.
​The Antidote: 
Liberty must realise that the universe has a plan for them that may not fit their inflexible ideas about how their life should pan out. An empowered Liberty surrenders and lets go, allowing their higher self to be in charge. They may go on many magical side adventures and might not achieve their goals as quickly as they would like, but they must trust that what is meant for them will come to them. As Lao Tzu said: 'By letting go it all gets done. The world is won by those that let it go. But if you try and try the world is beyond the winning'

cards.name: Deathcap
cards.up:
2. DEATHCAP
​Step into your power
​Botanical name: Amanita phalloides.
​Energy: deadly, cloaking and dark.
​Other names: deadly amanita.
​Traditional/medicinal uses: it is the subject of research for medicinal potential.
​Magickal/historical uses: no known magickal uses.
​THE POISON
Deathcap has been taught to be quiet from an early age, shutting down powerful emotions again and again to make life easier for those around them. Deathcap was often silenced. They learned to be meek and not cause too much trouble, realising their strong and sensitive feelings were an inconvenience and would not be tolerated. To please others Deathcap became obedient and passive, trying very hard not to make any waves. They have repressed their strong feelings for so long they are starting to feel numb and powerless.
​THE ANTIDOTE
Deathcap has forgotten they are a powerful being, temporarily dulled by living in human form. They believed too much in what others said about them and have been overly dutiful and timid, which has clouded their light. Deathcap needs to step into their power and realise that their sensitivity is their strength. Their strong feelings are now safe to express, which will lead to powerful changes for themselves and the world. It is time for Deathcap to realise their strength and start by expressing their needs and wishes in relationships.

cards.name: Thornapple
cards.up:
13. THORNAPPLE
​Embrace your weirdness
​Botanical name: Datura stramonium
​Energy: unique, powerful, and hallucinogenic
​Other names: datura, devil's trumpet, jimsonweed
​Traditional / Medicinal uses: Used topically in folk remedies to help ease inflammation.
​Magickal / Historical uses: In ancient times, priestesses and oracles used the plant to assist with prophetic visions. Its distinctive appearance makes it unmistakable.
​The Poison: 
Represents feeling self-conscious or hiding one's true, unique self out of fear of judgment, leading to dulling one's personal expression to fit in with the crowd.
​The Antidote: 
Encourages standing out, embracing one's unique personality and creative style, and realizing that authenticity brings joy and opens the way for others to express themselves freely.

cards.name: Rider
cards.up: News is coming fast — good or bad, it's on its way now.
cards.rev: Delays. The news, the visitor, the opportunity — it's not coming as fast as you hoped.

cards.name: Clover
cards.up: A small stroke of luck. Take it, don't overthink a gift horse.
cards.rev: Luck that's about to run out. Don't bet on this one.

cards.name: Ship
cards.up: Travel or a big move — leaving something familiar behind, for real this time.
cards.rev: A trip cancelled, or leaving in a way that burns bridges.

cards.name: House
cards.up: Stability, home, family — the foundation is solid right now.
cards.rev: Domestic tension, or a home life that's anything but stable.

cards.name: Tree
cards.up: Slow, deep-rooted growth — health, or something that takes real time to build.
cards.rev: Stagnant growth, or health issues that have been ignored too long.

cards.name: Clouds
cards.up: Confusion, and it's not clearing up soon. Don't decide anything today.
cards.rev: The fog is lifting, finally, after real confusion.

cards.name: Snake
cards.up: Betrayal or a complication with a hidden agenda. Someone's not straight with you.
cards.rev: The deception is unravelling — you're starting to see who's actually been lying.

cards.name: Coffin
cards.up: A hard, definitive ending. No resurrecting this one.
cards.rev: An ending that's dragging out longer than it should. Just let it die already.

cards.name: Bouquet
cards.up: A genuine gift or kind gesture — accept it, it's not a trick.
cards.rev: A gesture that looks nice but has strings attached.

cards.name: Scythe
cards.up: A sudden, sharp cut — a decision or event that happens fast and can't be undone.
cards.rev: A cut that should have happened already but you're avoiding it.

cards.name: Whip
cards.up: Conflict, arguing, repetitive tension — it's going to be a fight.
cards.rev: Old arguments resurfacing, the same fight on repeat.

cards.name: Birds
cards.up: Anxious chatter, gossip, nervous energy — two of everything, noisy and scattered.
cards.rev: The gossip's about to turn ugly, or anxiety's spiralling out of control.

cards.name: Child
cards.up: A fresh, naive start — something small and new that needs protecting.
cards.rev: Immaturity, or a new start that's being handled carelessly.

cards.name: Fox
cards.up: Someone's being clever at your expense. Watch your back at work.
cards.rev: The trick's been exposed. The clever one just got caught.

cards.name: Bear
cards.up: Strength and protection, but also someone dominating the room — could be a boss, could be jealousy.
cards.rev: Possessiveness or jealousy turning ugly, an authority figure abusing power.

cards.name: Stars
cards.up: Genuine hope and clarity — a plan that's actually got a clear path.
cards.rev: Lost direction, hope that's fading into disappointment.

cards.name: Stork
cards.up: A real change is coming, and it's overdue. Embrace the shift.
cards.rev: Resistance to a change you badly need to make.

cards.name: Dog
cards.up: Loyalty, real friendship — someone who's actually got your back.
cards.rev: A friend who's let you down, or trust misplaced.

cards.name: Tower
cards.up: Isolation, bureaucracy, being cut off — an institution or ego wall keeping people out.
cards.rev: Loneliness that's finally being broken through — reconnecting after distance.

cards.name: Garden
cards.up: A public event, socialising — being seen, for better or worse.
cards.rev: Social anxiety, or being talked about behind your back.

cards.name: Mountain
cards.up: A real obstacle, and it's not moving. Big, blocking, unavoidable.
cards.rev: An obstacle finally clearing after being stuck for a long time.

cards.name: Crossroads
cards.up: A real choice with real consequences — no easy option, pick one.
cards.rev: Indecision that's paralysing you. Not choosing is still a choice.

cards.name: Mice
cards.up: Slow loss — something's being eaten away, bit by bit, and you've been ignoring it.
cards.rev: The bleeding stops. Loss slowing down, damage control working.

cards.name: Heart
cards.up: Genuine love or passion, currently strong.
cards.rev: Heartbreak, or love that's cooling off fast.

cards.name: Ring
cards.up: Commitment, a binding agreement — contracts, marriage, promises that are meant to last.
cards.rev: A commitment breaking, or a contract that's about to fall through.

cards.name: Book
cards.up: Hidden information, a secret that hasn't surfaced yet — knowledge withheld.
cards.rev: The secret's out. Whatever was hidden is now exposed.

cards.name: Letter
cards.up: A real message or document is coming — pay attention when it lands.
cards.rev: Miscommunication, a message that gets lost, ignored, or misread.

cards.name: Man
cards.up: A male figure relevant to the reading — decisive, present, active.
cards.rev: A man being unreliable, absent, or acting against your interest.

cards.name: Woman
cards.up: A female figure relevant to the reading — independent, clear-headed.
cards.rev: A woman being manipulative, or acting from jealousy or spite.

cards.name: Lily
cards.up: Mature calm, sexuality, or a peace that's earned through experience, not naivety.
cards.rev: Repressed desire, or an older situation turning uncomfortable or inappropriate.

cards.name: Sun
cards.up: Straightforward success and vitality. No hidden catch — enjoy it.
cards.rev: Burnout, or a success that's temporary and fading fast.

cards.name: Moon
cards.up: Recognition, reputation, or emotional intuition running strong right now.
cards.rev: A damaged reputation, or emotions clouding your judgment badly.

cards.name: Key
cards.up: A real solution — the answer that actually unlocks the problem.
cards.rev: The solution isn't working, or you're missing the obvious key.

cards.name: Fish
cards.up: Money flowing, business thriving — abundance that's actually moving, not stuck.
cards.rev: Financial trouble, money slipping through your fingers faster than it comes in.

cards.name: Anchor
cards.up: Stability and security that's genuinely solid — something worth staying for.
cards.rev: Feeling stuck, not stable — stagnation disguised as security.

cards.name: Cross
cards.up: A real burden, unavoidable — suffering that has to be carried, not skipped.
cards.rev: The burden's easing, or a hard truth is finally being accepted, reducing the weight.
